# 29. V5 Audit — Admission Success & One-Platform Concierge

*2026-09-29, before any V5 code change. Method: code and data inspection of the running system (models, services, seeded data) against the V5 pillars. Research on visa routes, university submission methods, competitors and official arrival facts runs as separate sourced workstreams (`docs/research/`, `docs/VISA_ROUTES.md`, `docs/COMPETITOR_BENCHMARK.md`, `docs/ARRIVAL_SERVICES.md`).*

| Pillar | What exists (V4) | Gap against V5 |
|---|---|---|
| Admission strategy | Explainable matching (STRONG/COMPETITIVE/REACH/NOT_ELIGIBLE with reasons), readiness items, one next step per application | No per-application "what still lowers this application" list across documents + writing + language recommendations + interview; no portfolio view (how many strong/possible, deadline concentration, budget spread); counselors cannot review a portfolio |
| Writing review | Essay, versions, anchored comments with suggestions and visibility, deterministic pre-check (length, section cues, prompt keyword overlap), statuses | Prompt is a free-text copy on the essay — not versioned per university/program/intake with source; no rubric; no fact verification against the profile; no quality gate; no reviewer matching or writing SLA/escalation; no writing queue views; no link from essay version to outcome; no AI provider (no API key on this machine) |
| Documents | Vault reused across applications, per-requirement checklist, legalization path per issuing country (5 countries), `max_age_days` on requirements | No dossier view of "ready for N of your applications"; per-application applicability computed only inside each application; no detection of near-expiry, duplicates, name/date mismatch; no extraction suggestions; no package builder summary (ready / waiting on student / waiting on counselor) |
| Submission | Status SUBMITTED set by agency/student; no evidence required | No per-university/intake submission method, provider, fee method, confirmation; no guided hand-off; no receipt/confirmation record; application fee status not tracked; Hangyul fee vs university fee vs tuition not distinguished on the application |
| Visa | VisaRequirement rows: 45 generic + China 4 + Vietnam 4; VisaCase with completed steps; preview before admission | Only 2 of 14 priority countries have country-specific rows; no jurisdiction (which embassy/consulate), no application method (e-visa vs in person), no document validity periods, no form preparation, no reuse view, no submission/appointment/decision recording, no "embassy asked for something" state |
| Arrival & life in Korea | HousingCase (single record), ArrivalPlan (flight number, pickup_requested flag, completed items), Dormitory catalogue | No service fulfilment model; pickup is a boolean; no flight changes, driver/provider, statuses; no off-campus/temporary housing flows, lease review, move-in; settlement (SIM, bank, residence card, insurance, orientation) only as checklist text; no help routing |
| Agency operations | Today queue, tasks, messages, document/essay review | No service-case queue (visa support, pickup, housing, arrival); no vendors; essay reviews not SLA-tracked in Today |
| One journey | Contextual home with six phases and one next step | After the visa, home does not switch to housing → flight → pickup → settlement as the main track |
| Metrics | Funnel/yield metrics with definitions; agency performance per intake | No outcome metrics for duplicate uploads avoided, first-pass document acceptance, essay turnaround/revision rounds, visa extra-document requests, service-case completion |
| Localization | Burmese student/mobile machine drafts | Server-generated text (task titles, visa rule text) still English — Flow C (Myanmar, Burmese, no English leakage in the core workflow) would fail today |

**Honesty constraints carried into V5:** no admission probabilities, no "guaranteed" unless a stored partner contract says so, historical outcomes only with cohort + n + period, no invented providers/partners/listings, no pretend-live flight data, no portal scraping or stored portal passwords, no automatic declarations on official forms, AI never writes the student's statement.

# 30. V5 Plan

| Workstream | Scope | Owns |
|---|---|---|
| Research: visa + submission | Official visa playbooks for 14 markets; submission method for the 10 catalogued universities | `docs/research/visa-playbooks.json`, `submission-methods.json`, `post-arrival-official.json`, `docs/VISA_ROUTES.md` |
| Research: competitors + arrival | Current competitor benchmark; official arrival facts (residence card, NHIS, bank, SIM, transport, orientation, emergency) | `docs/COMPETITOR_BENCHMARK.md`, `docs/research/arrival-official.json`, `docs/ARRIVAL_SERVICES.md` (research part) |
| Admission success + submission | Strategy layer (per-application improvement list with reasons), portfolio view + counselor review, submission connectors (method per university/intake, guided hand-off, receipts, fee status) | i18n `success`; `server/app/services/strategy.py`, `submission.py`, `api/v1/success.py` |
| Universal dossier | Dossier + applicability per application, document intelligence, extraction suggestions, package builder | i18n `dossier`; `services/dossier.py`, `api/v1/dossier.py` |
| Writing review | Versioned prompts per university/program/intake, rubric, automatic checks + fact verification, quality gate, reviewer matching, SLA + escalation, writing queue, outcome link, AI provider abstraction (off by default) | i18n `writing`; `services/writing.py`, `api/v1/writing.py` |
| Concierge | ServiceCase + vendors + fulfilment queue; airport pickup + flight; housing (dorm / partner / off-campus / temporary, lease review, move-in); settlement steps; "Need help in Korea?" | i18n `concierge`; `services/concierge.py`, `api/v1/concierge.py` |
| Visa concierge (after research) | Route resolver from playbooks, reuse of dossier documents, form preparation (student confirms), statuses in student language, guided official hand-off, help | i18n `visaroute`; `services/visa_routes.py`, `api/v1/visa_routes.py` |
| Integration (coordinator) | Contextual home across all stages, agency Today with all work types, metrics, Burmese for the core workflow, E2E flows A–G, docs, gates | shared files |

Execution rules: one owner per new file set; shared files (`models/__init__.py`, router registration, app routers/nav, `student.py` dashboard, `agency.py` Today) edited with small in-place edits only; Alembic revisions created and applied inside `/tmp/claude-0/hg-migrate.lock` on top of the current head.

*Seven workstreams (two research, five build) plus a localization pass and coordinator integration. Each wrote a log in `docs/qa/v5/logs/`. Migrations, applied in order to a single head: `d5a1c0e55ccd` (success) → `e5c0c1e2a7b1` (concierge) → `a5e7c1d2b901` (writing) → `f5d055e1a001` (dossier) → `f5e1a2b3c454` (visa routes).*

## 31.1 Research (no code)

| Output | What it contains | Honesty status |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/research/visa-playbooks.json` + `docs/VISA_ROUTES.md` | 41 routes for NP, MM, VN, UZ, MN, CN, IN, BD, PK, ID, TH, PH, KZ, KG (D-2 levels, D-4-1): jurisdiction, application method, e-visa condition, documents with validity/legalization/provider, financial evidence, fees, special notes, sources with quotes. National rules taken from the Ministry of Justice manuals on HiKorea (visa manual 2026-09-01, stay manual 2026-09-18). | 15 VERIFIED, 25 PARTIAL (gaps listed per route), 1 NEEDS_REVIEW (Pakistan D-4-1). Nothing inferred across countries. |
| `docs/research/submission-methods.json` + `docs/SUBMISSION_CONNECTORS.md` | Submission method for the 10 catalogued universities: all through application providers (UWAY, JinhakApply, Gradnet); fees, upload vs post, confirmation. | No public university API exists; three fee pages are image-only and flagged for re-check. |
| `docs/research/post-arrival-official.json`, `docs/research/arrival-official.json`, `docs/ARRIVAL_SERVICES.md` | Residence card (90 days, HiKorea, KRW 35,000 since 2025-01-01), NHIS (D-2 from entry; other D-4 after 6 months; 50% reduction), bank account without/with residence card, SIM counters at ICN T1, T-money, help lines. | 2026 premium figure is from a university notice; carrier postpaid rule and several transport facts NEEDS_REVIEW. |
| `docs/COMPETITOR_BENCHMARK.md` | 15 services × 15 capabilities with sources; pain points; 10 product principles. | Key finding: global platforms do not serve Korea end to end; Korea splits into official information, application systems and manual agencies; parent communication is almost absent; unverifiable "98–99%" success claims are common. |

## 31.2 Admission success + submission (`services/strategy.py`, `services/submission.py`, `api/v1/success.py`, namespace `success`)

- **Strategy per application**: READY / IMPROVABLE / BLOCKED with an ordered list of items (code, severity, owner, reason, action link, sample flag) from real data — eligibility, language (plus a *recommended* level where seeded as sample data), fit, deadline feasibility, budget, scholarships, document readiness incl. legalization/expiry, essay readiness, interview, open university requests. No score, no percentage, no probability; historical context only with ≥5 real decided applications (never in the demo).
- **Portfolio** for students ("Your plan": Strong / Possible / Not eligible yet, deadline clusters, budget spread, plain observations) and a **Portfolio tab** for counselors answering the six questions (too few? too hard? unnecessary? deadlines concentrated? budget? another realistic option?) with a recorded review.
- **Submission hub**: connector types DIRECT_API · PARTNER_API · APPLICATION_PROVIDER · AGENCY_ASSISTED · GUIDED_EXTERNAL · MANUAL; per-university method, provider, portal, fee and payee, documents accepted, confirmation method, source and verification. `DirectApiConnector` raises NotConfigured. Guided hand-off: "Your Hangyul application is ready" → what is ready (documents, essays, fee labelled as the university's, not Hangyul's and not tuition; "never share your portal password") → *Continue to official submission* (records HANDED_OFF) → back: confirmation number / date / fee / receipt. SUBMITTED only with evidence; the student transition to SUBMITTED without evidence returns 409; counselor submissions create a record (confirmed only with a reference). The university applicant page shows method, reference and date.

## 31.3 Universal dossier (`services/dossier.py`, `services/extraction.py`, `api/v1/dossier.py`, namespace `dossier`)

- One dossier per student: canonical documents, versions, verification, translation, legalization, expiry, issuing country — and **applicability per application** (reusable · needs a newer copy with the reason · needs apostille/consular by issuing country and date · translation · expired · near expiry · 6-month passport margin labelled as a Hangyul rule).
- **Document intelligence**: expired, near expiry, new copy needed, legalization, translation, poor scan (image header), unreadable PDF, wrong type, name/birth-date/graduation-date mismatch, duplicates; staff can resolve or dismiss per file version.
- **Extraction as suggestions**: `pdftotext`/MRZ with check digits in a capped subprocess; values stored masked where sensitive; profile changes only on explicit *Confirm*. No OCR on this machine (stated in the UI).
- **Package builder** per application ("8 requirements · 3 ready · 3 waiting for you · 2 waiting for your counselor" → "Your application documents are ready.").
- **Duplicate minimisation**: upload asks "Keep using it / Replace it / Add a different version" with the reason; university requests offer **Send your existing …** or **Upload a newer …** (FLOW B).
- Student Documents page rebuilt phone-first; agency workspace gets the same dossier panel.

## 31.4 Writing review (`services/writing.py`, `services/ai_provider.py`, `api/v1/writing.py`, namespace `writing`)

- **Versioned university prompts** per university/program/intake with source and verification; all demo prompts labelled *Sample wording*; an essay without a known question says so and reviewers can attach it.
- **Automatic checks** (rule-based, labelled "Automatic check", never edit text): length/language, coverage of each part of the question, repetition, generic phrasing, other-university mentions, misspelled names, overlap with another student's essay (team only, never showing the other text), **fact verification** against the profile (graduation year, degree, GPA, TOPIK/IELTS, nationality, school, age) as "the sentence + your profile says … please check".
- **Rubric** of 16 dimensions rated Meets / Needs work / Not assessed — no score. **Quality gate** blocks approval (409) while a blocker is open; only a manager can override, with a reason recorded in the audit log.
- **Reviewer matching** with visible reasons (language, degree, field, university, country, expertise, workload, SLA), auto-assigned on first submission; manager reassignment with reason. **SLA** 48 h first/revision, 24 h final; overdue → reviewer task + manager escalation; the student sees the true status ("Assigned to … · expected by …"; "flagged to the manager" only once escalated).
- **Agency queue** (Needs first review · Student revised · Final review · Due within 48 h · Overdue · Assigned to me · Team) and a review workspace with context header, highlighted comments, explicit *Comment to student* vs *Internal note*, checks/rubric/gate/versions panels, *Next essay*.
- **Approved version** is what the application uses (the student no longer uploads the statement separately). **Outcome feedback** for managers at `/essays/insights` (groups n<5 withheld, no causal claims). AI provider switch `HG_AI_PROVIDER` defaults to off; no API key exists here.

## 31.5 Visa concierge (`services/visa_routes.py`, `api/v1/visa_routes.py`, namespace `visaroute`)

- The 41 researched routes are loaded into versioned tables; each route keeps its research status; countries without a route say "we haven't verified the rules for {country} yet — your counselor confirms them" (old generic checklist kept as fallback).
- **Route resolver** from nationality, residence, degree/program (D-2-x / D-4-1), university certification tier (seeded UNKNOWN everywhere, so no e-visa is offered in the demo), jurisdiction (one question only when a country has several posts: Vietnam region, China hukou, India passport place of issue, Pakistan/Kazakhstan region), sponsor, admission status, issuing countries. Nepal and Myanmar resolve to their own playbooks.
- **Document reuse** through the dossier hook, judged on the appointment date ("Passport — Ready", "Bank balance certificate — new one required for the visa, get it on or after …").
- **Preparation form** prefilled for the student's own check — staff cannot confirm it, corrections never overwrite the profile, nothing is declared. READY when the pack is complete; submission recorded only with a receipt; visa ISSUED only with the visa uploaded (this switches the home to the arrival track). Embassy requests → student task + VISA_SUPPORT service case.
- **Visa page** redesigned phone-first; the coordinator then folded the form, tracking, step list, extra caveats and help behind disclosures (Mongolian persona: 7.5 → 3.7 phone screens).

## 31.6 Concierge (`services/concierge.py`, `api/v1/concierge.py`, namespace `concierge`)

- **One ServiceCase model** for VISA_SUPPORT, AIRPORT_PICKUP, DORMITORY, HOUSING_SEARCH, TEMPORARY_HOUSING, ARRIVAL_SUPPORT, RESIDENCE_CARD, SIM, BANKING_SUPPORT, OTHER — per-type status tables (each status says who it waits on), student-visible status, SLA, vendor, cost with payer, history, tasks.
- **Providers**: shown as a partner only with an active agreement; demo providers always say "Demo provider".
- **Airport pickup + flight**: statuses Not booked → Requested → Confirmed → Driver assigned → Flight delayed → Driver waiting → Picked up → Completed; driver requires a provider; completion requires proof; flight times always labelled manual ("not live"); delays ≥30 min move the pickup; flight changes after confirmation create a re-confirm task.
- **Housing** decision (dormitory / partner / off-campus / temporary / undecided), useful preferences only, dormitory facts with source, demo listings clearly labelled, lease review with practical flags (no legal conclusions), move-in checklist.
- **Your first weeks in Korea**: quiet before admission; after the visa "You're ready to come to Korea" → housing → flight → pickup → documents to carry → SIM → orientation; after arrival residence card (90-day task), health insurance, bank, transport, registration — each with an official source or NEEDS_REVIEW; research English shown behind "Official text, as published" disclosures. **Need help in Korea?** routes to agency or Hangyul ops (medical: urgent + emergency numbers).
- Agency **Services** queue (Needs assignment · Waiting on student · Waiting on provider · Scheduled · Today · Overdue · Completed) and **Providers** page; service-quality metrics with n<5 withheld.

## 31.7 Localization (Burmese, FLOW C)

- 181 student, 54 mobile and other student-facing keys translated (machine draft, labelled as such in the app); Latin fragments inside Burmese strings removed.
- Chromium ships no Burmese date data → `packages/utils/src/intl-fallback.ts` supplies Burmese month/day/relative/country names when the browser can't.
- Server English that reached students now carries codes + params (checklist actions, strategy notes, notification params, legalization notes); the UI renders translated keys with English as fallback. `scripts/qa/leak-check.mjs` checks every core screen for Latin-script words outside proper names, amounts, test names and quoted sources: **0 leaks for 8 personas at 390 and 1440** on the core workflow (report `docs/qa/v5/i18n/leak-report.md`).

## 31.8 Coordinator integration

- **One journey on Home** (server `me/dashboard` + web + native): the next step now follows the stage — profile unlock (exploring) → the application's most urgent item (preparing) → **guided submission** (READY) → offers → **the named visa document** (visa) → **arrival steps** (visa issued) → **residence card and settlement** (arrived). "What you can do today" (top three improvements) and dossier nudges sit under the hero.
- **One Agency Today**: essay reviews (overdue / due within 48 h / revised), service cases (the Services view's own count), **visa cases** (appointments within 7 days, embassy requests, packs ready), document checks — alongside the V4 queues; each count opens the list it counts.
- **Outcome metrics** (`GET /agency/outcome-metrics`, *Outcome quality* on agency Performance): time to application-ready, completeness at submission, submissions with evidence, missed deadlines, first-pass document acceptance, duplicate uploads avoided, extra documents per application, essay turnaround, revision rounds, essay SLA breaches, service completion, service SLA breach, arrival support completion — each with its definition and population, n<5 withheld. University pipeline metrics add **complete on first review** and **additional-document request rate**; the Overview shows the first with numerator/denominator.
- **Language at sign-in**: the student app opens in the account's saved language unless a language was chosen on the device (Hnin sees Burmese immediately).
- **Daily job** runs the writing SLA sweep and outcome recording. Shared task/notification keys (submission confirmation, writing overdue/escalation, concierge tasks, 40 visa document tasks) added in en/ko/my; `notify.serviceCase` translates its enum parameters by nesting.
- **Personas** (all `Hangyul!2026`): Aarati — Nepal, application READY (FLOW A); Hnin — Myanmar, visa preparation, Burmese (FLOW C); Thư — Vietnam, dossier reuse/newer copy (FLOW B); Enkhjin — Mongolia, visa route (FLOW E); Huy — visa issued, pickup requested (FLOW F); Vy — arrived, residence card; plus writing reviewer `writing@demo.hangyul.kr`.
- Native student home handles the new next-step types (visa document, arrival steps, submission).

## 32.4 Found and fixed during the final review

- Visa page too long (≈7.5 phone screens): form, tracking, step list, extra caveats and help folded behind disclosures → 3.7.
- Arrived students were told "Book housing and your flight" by the journey line → stage-specific text.
- Burmese users saw English after signing in (web and native used only the device/browser language) → account language applies unless one was chosen on the device.
- Native home showed the application deadline during the visa stage → pre-submission only.
- 768 px overflow on Applications (new strategy line pushed the chevron out) → the row's end group wraps.
- Today essay row: the test clicked the loading placeholder link; the product link was right — test waits for the real link.

# 34. V6 Independent Visual & Product Audit

*Written 2026-10-01, before any V6 change. Method: the full REPORT (§1–33) was read as a list of claims; the running system (`npm run dev`, fresh after a VM restart) was used as every persona; 176 "before" captures were taken with `scripts/qa/v6-capture.mjs` (first viewport + full page, marketing at 390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1728, other key screens at 390 and 1440, metrics in `docs/qa/v6/before/metrics.json`) and looked at by eye. References were captured with `scripts/qa/_refshot.mjs` into `docs/qa/v6/references/`.*

## 34.1 What the earlier passes optimised for — and what they did not

V2–V5 made the product *correct, calm and honest*: one next step per state, one cost model, defined metrics, sourced facts, no fake proof. They did not make it *desirable*. Every V2–V5 decision was a reduction (remove cards, pills, colour, orbs, testimonials) and nothing was added back to carry emotion. The result is a product that is hard to fault and easy to forget.

## 34.2 Marketing — what looks bad

| # | Observation (1440×900 and 390×844 first viewport) | Why it fails |
|---|---|---|
| M1 | The hero is a 52px headline on an off-white canvas with ~300px of empty space above it and a bordered form card on the right. No image, no colour field, no Korea. | Nothing creates the feeling "I want to be there". It reads as a SaaS sign-up page. |
| M2 | The quick-eligibility check is an admin form (select + 9 chips + full-width button inside a hairline card). On a phone it fills the entire first viewport. | The most useful interaction looks like paperwork; on mobile it *is* the hero, so there is no hero. |
| M3 | Below the hero: a 6-step numbered line, two product mock panels, a 6-statement trust list, a two-column "universities and agencies" block, a guides list, a CTA — all on the same off-white, same type, same hairlines (5.1 screens at 1440, 8.3 at 390). | No visual rhythm, no scale change, no image; the "boring section stack" the brief describes. |
| M4 | Brand presence = a 24px tangerine logo and orange buttons. Hangyul's own public landing (talkhangyul.com, `hangyul-web/public/og-image.png`) uses charcoal, a large tangerine sun-circle and confident display type — none of that reached Hangyul Univ. | Not recognisably Hangyul; nothing to remember after five seconds. |
| M5 | Public `/universities` is a filter sidebar + rows of initials badges ("KH"), "Partner (demo)" pills and a dev banner sentence above the results. | Database search page, not discovery; "demo" pills on every row. |
| M6 | Footer and several sections carry environment copy ("This environment uses development sample data", "sample data" captions under product mocks). | Development language on the public face of the product. |

**Why the homepage is not emotionally attractive:** it explains instead of showing. It has no photograph, no place, no people's world, no scale contrast and no brand colour field; the only interaction is a form. Honesty was implemented as *absence* (no fake testimonials → no social or human content at all) rather than as *authentic content* (real places, real process, real sources).

## 34.3 Consoles — what looks bad

| # | Observation | Why it fails |
|---|---|---|
| C1 | Agency, University and Hangyul HQ share one look: warm off-white canvas, grey sidebar, tangerine (`#CC4E00`) buttons, badges and counters. | The professional workspace looks like the consumer app; tangerine reads as "marketing" in an operations tool and as alarm in counters (the "3" task badge looks like an error). |
| C2 | A dark full-width strip "Demo environment — all people, partnerships and numbers are sample data." on every console and student page, plus "(Demo)" in agency names ("Lotus Bridge Education (Demo)"), "(sample)" in school names, "Partner (demo)" pills, "Sample wording" on essay prompts, "Demo provider" on services. | The UI looks like a test build; the environment indicator is repeated on rows instead of once. |
| C3 | Login pages list every demo account with the password in clear text ("Password for all demo accounts: Hangyul!2026") as a long list below the form. | Looks unprofessional; mixes test instructions into the product; not a persona picker. |
| C4 | University console has no institutional character: same sidebar as the agency, page titles at 24px with bordered white panels, a blue funnel bar on a warm canvas. | Fine for daily work, not "appropriate in a meeting with a university president". |
| C5 | Hangyul HQ is three extra links inside the agency sidebar (Agencies, Assignment override, Sources & freshness). Sources is a 50-row table of "Review due" pills with no grouping by risk. | No command centre: nothing answers "what is at risk across agencies, universities, services and data right now?" |
| C6 | Writing review workspace: the essay is a 350px-wide column between a metadata grid card and a 220px comments rail; metadata repeats "(Demo)" and "Sample wording … not the university's official question". | The writing does not dominate; it looks like a form with an essay in it. |

## 34.4 Product — re-audit from zero (KEEP / IMPROVE / MERGE / MOVE / REMOVE / REBUILD)

| Feature | Verdict | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Public quick eligibility (3 questions → counts) | **IMPROVE** | Most valuable public interaction; must become part of the hero, not a form card. |
| Marketing home | **REBUILD** | See §34.2. |
| Public university discovery | **REBUILD** (presentation) | Data and API are right; presentation is a database page. |
| Marketing secondary pages (How it works, Services, Partners) | **IMPROVE** | Same composition problem, lower priority. |
| Student journey (home, application workspace, one next step) | **KEEP** | Verified working through V5; visual polish only. |
| Student universities/compare/budget | **KEEP** | Correct; inherits new marketing card language for consistency. |
| Universal dossier / package builder | **KEEP** | Matches the brief (upload once, reuse, per-application package). |
| Writing review (agency) | **IMPROVE** | Feature depth is high (checks, rubric, gate, SLA, matching, versions, suggestions decided by the student, internal notes); layout must let the text dominate, and the review loop must be faster (open next → decide → next). |
| Submission connectors | **IMPROVE** | Guided hand-off works; the *authorised agency* path (student consent → agency "ready to submit" queue → reference + receipt) does not exist as a flow — `AGENCY_ASSISTED` only lets a counselor record a submission without student authorisation. |
| Visa route resolver | **KEEP** | V5 work is sound; presentation only. |
| Concierge (pickup, housing, settlement) | **KEEP** | One ServiceCase model with honest statuses; presentation only. |
| Demo labelling (banner + per-row "(Demo)/Sample") | **REBUILD** | Replace with one development-environment indicator + a dev-only Demo access persona picker. |
| Login demo-account lists with password | **REMOVE** | Replaced by Demo access (no passwords shown). |
| Agency/University visual language | **REBUILD** | Blue console design system (§36). |
| Hangyul HQ | **IMPROVE** → operations overview | Cross-agency / university / service / source risk in one place. |
| `writing@demo` persona | **FIX** | Cannot sign in (seed never sets its password) — the V5 writing reviewer persona is unusable. |

## 34.5 Honesty constraints carried into V6

No fabricated testimonials, partners, acceptance rates or outcomes on public pages. Synthetic seed data stays isolated (`is_demo`), is never shown as production achievement, and is disclosed **once** by the environment indicator rather than on every row. Photography is used only with a licence that allows commercial use, with credits recorded. Integrations that need a provider agreement are labelled "awaiting provider integration", never simulated.

| Reference | What it does well | What Hangyul takes | What Hangyul rejects |
|---|---|---|---|
| **edm 세계유학박람회 (edmsaf.com)** | Full-bleed real photography of people at the fair; a huge confident headline over the image; urgency (D-9 countdown bar); one obvious conversion button repeated; perceived scale ("국내 최대", 11 countries, 2,000 schools). | Image-led first viewport; type scale contrast; a single conversion action that stays reachable; energy. | Coupon/event clutter, lottery prizes, colour noise (purple + green + red), unverifiable "largest" claims, carousels with autoplay. |
| **Study in Korea (studyinkorea.go.kr)** | Information architecture: search by **school / major / scholarship / job** as four entry points; "Plan your studies in 5 steps"; audience splits (want to come / studying now / graduated); university logos; life/work in Korea. | Discovery entry points (university, program, scholarship); a 5-step journey that maps to our product; Life in Korea as its own chapter. | Government-portal density, modal pop-ups, icon clip-art, carousels, the generic stock students. |
| **Hangyul brand (talkhangyul.com og-image; BI guide)** | Charcoal field, a large tangerine sun-circle, bold geometric wordmark, Hangul glyph texture, product shown in a phone. | The tangerine circle as the one memorable visual idea; charcoal + warm paper + tangerine as the marketing palette; Catalpa/Pretendard pairing. | — |
| **Hangyul Figma (한귤_랜딩페이지, node 1058-9903)** | **Not accessible from this environment** (anonymous fetch returns a CloudFront 403; the Figma connector needs the owner's interactive sign-in). Its contents are **not** described or imitated here. | — | — |
| Best-in-class product UIs (Linear, Stripe Dashboard, Workday/Slate for admissions, Airbnb/Wise consumer flows) | Linear/Stripe: quiet chrome, one accent, dense type, keyboard. Slate (admissions CRM): formal reader view, committee workflow. Airbnb: image-first discovery cards. | Blue single-accent consoles; reader-first applicant/essay views; image-first university cards. | Feature-dashboard sprawl. |

**Experience principles distilled:** (1) show the place before the process; (2) the first interaction is personal ("where can *I* apply?") and answered instantly; (3) the journey is one story told visually, not six cards; (4) trust is earned by sources, people and responsibility statements — never invented proof; (5) professional tools are calm, blue, dense and keyboard-first; (6) the environment is disclosed once, not on every row.

# 36. V6 Design Direction

## 36.1 Two design languages, one brand

| | Consumer (marketing + student) | Professional (agency, university, Hangyul ops) |
|---|---|---|
| Feeling | Warm, aspirational, editorial, international | Precise, institutional, fast, calm |
| Canvas | Warm paper `#FAF8F4` + charcoal night sections `#16130F` | Cool canvas `#F5F7FB`, white surfaces, subtle `#EEF2F8` |
| Text | Ink `#181A1F` | Deep navy-ink `#0F1B2D`, secondary `#535D6E` (5.6:1 on canvas), tertiary `#667085` (4.6:1) |
| Action | Tangerine `#CC4E00` (AA) — act here / you are here | Cobalt `#2257D6` (white 6.2:1; on canvas 5.8:1), hover `#1B48B8`, pressed `#163C9A`, selected `#EAF0FD` |
| Brand | Tangerine `#FF6700` circle as a large graphic device; logo | Logo keeps its orange; nothing else is orange |
| Imagery | Licensed photography (CC0 / CC BY, credited) of campuses, cities, arrival | None — data and text |
| Type | Pretendard; display 56–88px with tight tracking on desktop, 40–44px on phones | Pretendard; 13–14px tables, 20–22px page titles, tabular numbers |
| Charts | — | Navy / cobalt / blue-grey / neutral; red/amber/green only for state |

Borders `#DCE2EB` (strong `#C4CDDA`). University console uses a deep navy sidebar `#0F2240` (text `#C7D2E4`, 10.4:1) for institutional weight; agency console keeps a light sidebar for density; Hangyul operations gets its own overview inside the agency console with a navy "Hangyul operations" context.

## 36.2 Marketing story (planned composition)

1. **Desire** — full-bleed photography of a Korean campus/city with the tangerine circle device and one headline; the quick check is a single sentence the student completes ("I'm from ___, I want to study ___, my language score is ___ → See where I can apply").
2. **Personal possibility** — the instant result inline (counts, three example programs, smallest language step that unlocks more), never a probability.
3. **The journey** — Discover → Apply → Admission → Visa → Arrive as one horizontal photographic sequence with the product moment for each stage.
4. **The product** — matching, documents, writing review, visa: real UI on a charcoal field.
5. **Universities** — image-first cards with identity, city, cost, deadline, language.
6. **Life in Korea** — arrival, housing, first weeks, with photography.
7. **Trust** — sources with dates, people who check your work, responsibility statement; no invented proof.
8. **CTA** — one action.

Three hero directions are prototyped before choosing (§37): **A. Cinematic Korea** (full-bleed photo, sentence-form check on a glass bar), **B. Editorial split** (big type on paper + asymmetric photo collage + live result card), **C. Interactive discovery** (map of Korea with university pins filtered by the check, charcoal + tangerine). Scored on emotional attraction, brand distinctiveness, clarity, conversion, trust, mobile quality and international appeal.

## 36.3 Environment and demo access

- One global, small **"Development"** indicator (bottom-left chip) in development builds or when `VITE_DEMO_LOGINS=true`; it opens a dev drawer explaining that the data is synthetic. No per-row labels: "(Demo)" suffixes, "(sample)" school names, "Partner (demo)", "Sample wording", "Demo provider" are removed from product surfaces and moved to the dev drawer / provenance tooltips. Data honesty is preserved by the `is_demo` / `verification_status` fields and by the indicator; production builds never show seeded data.
- **Demo access**: a small button in each product's header/login (dev only) opening a persona picker grouped by role (Student: exploring, preparing, offer, visa, arrived…; Agency: counselor, manager, document reviewer, writing reviewer; University: admissions officer, reviewer, administrator, analyst; Hangyul: operations, admin, finance). One click signs in through a dev-only API endpoint; no passwords are displayed.

## 36.4 Product changes in scope

- **Submission**: `AUTHORIZED_AGENCY` method — student "Authorize submission" consent (what, which university, which documents, fee, who submits) → agency **Ready to submit** queue → final review → record reference + receipt → student sees Submitted / reference / date / who / receipt. Connector-unavailable design: method, status, what Hangyul completed, what the person must do next — never a broken button.
- **Writing review**: manuscript-first layout (text dominates, context in a compact header, panels as one switchable rail), faster loop (approve / request changes → next essay, keyboard), AI suggestions visibly labelled when a provider is configured (none is, so none appear).
- **Hangyul operations overview**: cross-agency SLA, service cases, submissions awaiting agency, source freshness by risk.
- **Visa / arrival**: keep V5 logic; visual alignment only unless the audit finds a broken step.
- Everything else: reduction, not addition.

## 37.8 Direct university application (workstream; `docs/SUBMISSION_CONNECTORS.md` V6 section, log `docs/qa/v6/logs/submission.md`)

- **Research reality (2026-10, `COMPETITOR_BENCHMARK.md`):** no agency accounts, batch upload or API on UWAY, JinhakApply, Gradnet or Study in Korea; Korea University's guide requires applicants to submit personally; the common application form must be written by the applicant; JinhakApply's terms forbid third-party use of an ID. The design was changed mid-workstream accordingly.
- Methods DIRECT_API · PARTNER_API · **AUTHORIZED_AGENCY** (renamed from AGENCY_ASSISTED, old value read as alias) · APPLICATION_PROVIDER · GUIDED_EXTERNAL · MANUAL; each connector stores provider, portal, official URL, fee + payer, documents, credentials requirement (described, never stored), confirmation and receipt method, status-sync capability (NONE/MANUAL everywhere), verified date + source. Migration `e6a1b2c3d4f5`.
- **Works end to end:** guided self-submission for every catalogued university ("{University} requires you to submit the application yourself on {portal}. Everything is prepared — about N minutes (Hangyul's estimate)"; what Hangyul completed; exact steps; files to upload; what to enter, passport masked; "Continue to official submission" → "Did you submit?" with number/receipt/date; counselor final review shown with its date). Agency records evidence the student shares. SUBMITTED only with evidence (V5 rule kept).
- **Authorised agency submission:** consent screen (where it goes, form summary from the profile, documents, fee with payer/payee, who submits, withdrawable) → `SubmissionAuthorization` with a snapshot + `ConsentRecord` → agency **Ready to submit** queue `/submissions` (final review checklist, official portal opened in staff's own browser, reference required, receipt) → student sees Submitted · reference · date · who · receipt. Only allowed where a connector records `agency_submission_basis` and the agency holds a matching permission — **no real university has one**, so it is demonstrable only on a development fixture program ("Authorised-submission fixture (development only)", hidden from the catalogue, never created when `HG_ENV=production`; personas `student.authorize@` / `student.authorized@`).
- DIRECT_API / PARTNER_API: `NotConfigured` → "Awaiting provider integration", no button. Failure, duplicate, withdrawal and session-expiry paths handled. Tests: `test_v6_submission.py` (5) + `test_v5_success.py` (11); E2E `e2e/v6-submission.spec.ts`.

## 37.11 Personal-statement review (workstream; `docs/WRITING_REVIEW.md` V6 section, log `docs/qa/v6/logs/writing.md`, screenshots `docs/qa/v6/writing/`)

- **Reviewer workspace rebuilt manuscript-first:** sticky two-line context header (student · university · program · intake / type · version · round · status · deadline · reviewer + Reassign · review due with lateness and escalation), Approve and Request changes on the right; the university's actual question above the text (collapsible, staff see "Question not yet verified against the official guide" quietly when unverified); live word/character count vs limit; the essay in a 68-character serif reading column at 18 px; **one** side panel switching Comments · Checks · Rubric · Versions (a bottom sheet below 1100 px).
- **Review mechanics:** select text → Comment; student-visible comments blue, internal notes amber/dashed; suggestions show their state (Waiting for the student · Accepted on {date} in v{n} · Declined with the student's note · Resolved without a decision); resolved comments hidden behind "Show resolved"; automatic findings with a location are wavy-underlined in the text by severity; inline diff previous → current or any two versions; history shows approval, authorship statement per version and which application uses which version.
- **Rubric** regrouped into Quality (answers the question, specificity, authenticity, structure, logic, university fit, major fit, future plan, evidence, clarity) and Accuracy — each with a question for the reviewer, never a total.
- **Speed:** C comment · A approve · R request changes · N/J P/K comments · ] [ essays · D changes · 1–4 panels · ? sheet · Ctrl+Enter (never while typing); approve / request changes opens the next essay in the same queue view; queue view, order and position persist per user.
- **Student editor:** serif writing sheet under the question; reviewer comments beside the text in reading order; **Accept / Keep mine** per suggestion (only while the essay is back with the student); which version is approved and which application uses it; Submit (the only tangerine button) requires "These are my own words and facts".
- **Server** (migration `f6b7c8d9e0a1`, `app/models/v6_writing.py`): per-suggestion student decision (accepting creates a student-authored version; refused while the reviewer holds the text); authorship statement per version with a hash of the exact text (sent with submit; not yet *required* server-side so older mobile builds keep working); two new checks — **other program at the same university named** (warning) and **cross-application consistency** (conflicting graduation year / GPA / TOPIK / IELTS / age / home country between the student's essays; blocks approval until fixed or dismissed); `/next` honours the queue view and position.
- **AI:** none configured → nothing AI-related is shown; if a provider is enabled, its items carry an "AI suggestion" label and never edit the text.
- Tests: `test_v6_writing.py` 12, V5 writing suites + flows 28, vitest agency 6 / student 10 (writing), Playwright `e2e/v6-writing.spec.ts` 4.
- Coordinator: "comment(s) / suggestion(s) / blocker(s)" copy replaced with real plural forms or neutral wording (en/ko).

## 37.12 Final integration (coordinator) — found while running the gates

| Found | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| **Engine document tasks could name one application and point at another** ("Upload your family relationship certificate for Pusan National University" linked to the Kyungpook application, with Kyungpook's deadline). Surfaced as an intermittent failure of a V4 home test. | `tasks_engine` iterated a student's applications **without ORDER BY**; a document task shared by several applications was owned by whichever came first, and on later runs only its title was refreshed — `application_id`, university, link and deadline were not. | Deterministic order (created first) and every refresh keeps title, application, university, link and open deadline in step (`server/app/services/tasks_engine.py`). Full pytest: no failure in five consecutive runs. |
| **"Own words" blocker on almost every seeded essay** — 188 of 194 seeded statements shared 7-word passages, and real (E2E) essays collided with the generator's template sentences. | The V6 seed generator writes statements from shared templates; the similarity pool included them. | Synthetic seeded statements never take part in the comparison (they are nobody's work; production has none); real essays are still compared with every real essay (`services/writing.py`; regression test `test_seeded_statements_are_not_compared_with_each_other`). E2E specs given sentences of their own. |
| **"Check my draft" could check the previous version** | The check saved first only when the editor state was exactly "dirty"; an autosave already in flight left it "saving". | Saves whenever the on-screen text differs from the stored version or a save is pending (`student-web/pages/EssayEditor.tsx`). |
| **Production bundles contained every demo account email** (the persona list). | `DEMO_PERSONAS` was exported from `@hangyul/auth` and imported statically. | Personas moved to `@hangyul/auth/demo-personas`, loaded only through a build-time-guarded dynamic import (`import.meta.env.DEV \|\| VITE_DEMO_LOGINS`), so production builds drop the chunk: **0 bundles contain a demo email** after the change (verified by grep over `dist/`). Native picker imports the subpath (root-level fallback file for bundlers that ignore `exports`). |
| Native Agency and University apps were still tangerine | The blue system existed only in web CSS. | `@hangyul/design-tokens/console-surface` overrides the RN tokens (cobalt action, cool neutrals, navy-ink text) and is the first import of both apps' root layouts; verified on the Android emulator (screens `docs/qa/v6/android/`). Metro needed `--clear` to see the new subpath. |
| Console text below 12 px (sidebar section labels, keycaps, source-kind headings at 11 px; keycaps at 10 px / 60 % opacity) | New V6 rules | All raised to 12 px; keycaps tertiary colour instead of opacity. Only badge digits, avatar initials and the dev-only chip tag remain < 12 px (V4 standard). |
| axe: console sidebar section labels 3.7:1; tertiary text on the selected (light-blue) row 4.35:1; an unnamed sort button in the submissions table; marketing "not included" plan features 2.56:1; Arabic select chevrons mis-mirrored | — | Section labels and console tertiary text `#5F6B80` (5.4:1 on white, 4.7:1 on selected); column named "Status"; plan features tertiary text + dash marker; RTL chevron gradients re-ordered. |
| "comment(s) and suggestion(s)", "blocker(s)" | — | Real plural forms or neutral wording (en/ko). |
| Language control said "भाषा: Nepali" | aria-label used the English language name | Uses the language's own name. |
| University offer note (the university's own wording) counted as English leakage | — | Rendered as quoted university text (`data-user-content`), inside a translated sentence. |
| Home after the Guides section | Reduction | Guides removed from the home (nav + footer keep them); marketing `QuickCheck` card component, three unused product illustrations and 80 dead CSS rules deleted. |

# 38. V6 Final Stakeholder Review

*2026-10-01. Method: the running system after all changes, as each persona, at 390–1728 px on the web and on an Android 15 emulator; 175 "after" captures with the same script, personas and ids as the 176 "before" captures (`docs/qa/v6/{before,after}/`, `metrics.json`). Expert walkthrough plus scripted flows — no external participants. The development database could not be reset at the end (the reset command was refused by the session's permission policy), so the live demo data carries the effects of earlier E2E runs; the test suites reseed their own database.*

## 38.1 Answers to the brief's 25 report questions

1. **What looked bad before** — §34.2–34.3: a quiet SaaS hero (headline + form card on off-white), a uniform section stack, no photography, no brand colour field; consoles in the consumer's warm-tangerine look with a dark demo banner, "(Demo)"/"Sample" on rows, password lists on logins; Hangyul HQ as three links; the writing workspace a form with an essay in it.
2. **Why the homepage was not emotionally attractive** — it explained instead of showing: no place, no scale contrast, no brand device, and honesty implemented as absence rather than authentic content.
3. **Principles learned** — edm: image-led first viewport, bold headline, one repeated conversion. Study in Korea: discovery entry points and a 5-step plan, life in Korea as its own chapter. Hangyul's own landing: charcoal + the tangerine sun-circle. **Figma: not accessible** (CloudFront 403; connector requires the owner's sign-in) — not imitated.
4. **Hero concepts** — A cinematic Korea (32/35), B editorial split (27), C interactive map (27); §37.3, `docs/qa/v6/concepts/`.
5. **Final direction** — A, with B's sun as the closing device and the inner-page header; quick check as one sentence.
6. **Marketing redesign** — §37.4.
7. **Student** — destination photo band, Authorize step on home, visa jurisdiction question in places not research notes, phone application rows, premium writing editor (§37.5, §37.11), Nepali/Vietnamese parity (§37.10).
8. **Agency** — blue workbench, Today/Students/queues refined, "Ready to submit" queue, writing workspace rebuilt (§37.6, §37.8, §37.11).
9. **University** — navy institutional console, evidence panels, reader view for statements, decision queue navigation (§37.7).
10. **Hangyul admin** — operations overview `/hq`, sources by risk (§37.6).
11. **Blue console design system** — §36.1, §37.1; validated contrast and chart palette; native apps included (§37.12).
12. **Demo-data presentation** — one DEV chip; no per-row labels; realistic seed; production never shows seeded data; public pages never show synthetic partners (§37.9, §37.4).
13. **Demo access** — `/auth/demo-login` (refused in production), web persona picker on every product + `?demo=` hand-off, native pickers; no passwords shown; personas not shipped in production bundles.
14. **Direct-application architecture / 15. connectors** — §37.8, `docs/SUBMISSION_CONNECTORS.md` V6.
16. **Writing review** — §37.11.
17. **Visa** — jurisdiction question, research note removed; V5 resolver unchanged (§37.5, `VISA_ROUTES.md`).
18. **Housing / pickup / arrival** — presentation and research update (`ARRIVAL_SERVICES.md` V6), arrival in Hangyul operations, arrival promise on marketing; V5 ServiceCase model unchanged.
19. **Removed** — dark demo banner; login password lists; `DemoBanner`/`DemoBadge`; per-row "(Demo)/Sample/Demo provider/Partner (demo)"; the card-style quick check; three marketing illustrations; Guides from home; 80 dead CSS rules; "Research note (English)" on visa; synthetic partnership block on public university pages; prototype hero code.
20. **Merged** — environment disclosure + test accounts → one DEV chip with Demo access; quality gate → top of Checks + approve dialog; four writing panels → one switchable rail; university value evidence → one panel shared by Overview and Partnership; seed rename → idempotent live-DB script + seed.
21. **Screenshots** — before `docs/qa/v6/before/`, after `docs/qa/v6/after/` (+ `full/`), concepts, references, per-workstream folders, RTL `docs/qa/v6/rtl/`, i18n `docs/qa/v6/i18n/`, Android `docs/qa/v6/android/`.
22. **Measurements** — §38.3. 23. **Tests** — §38.4. 24/25. **Remaining integrations and limitations** — §39.

## 38.2 The four questions

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| Knowing nothing about Korea, would Hangyul feel more attractive, easier, safer and more trustworthy than Google + university sites + immigration pages + a traditional agency? | **Attractive: yes** — the first five seconds are a city, a promise and a sentence to complete. **Easier: yes** — eligibility in one sentence without an account; one next step per stage; guided submission names the portal, files, fee and what to type. **Safer / trustworthy: mostly** — sourced facts with dates, no invented chances or partners, privacy and responsibility statements; still limited by having no real company proof, reviews or partners yet (a business gap) and machine-draft translations. |
| Would an agency want its counselors in this every day? | **Yes for documents, writing, services and deadlines** — Today is a work queue, the writing workspace is faster than Word + comments + chat (inline comments, student-decided suggestions, diff, gate, shortcuts, next-essay), service cases and submissions have queues. **Not yet for communication** — external channels (Kakao, WhatsApp, email) are modelled, not integrated. |
| Would a Korean university international office consider Hangyul a serious technology and recruitment partner? | **Plausibly yes** — the console reads as institutional software; the value is shown with its own numbers and n (82% complete on first review, 100% of shared documents verified, retention and on-time graduation for Hangyul cohorts); request loop and reader view work. **Missing for procurement:** SAML/SCIM, scheduled exports, real outcome data. |
| Five seconds on the homepage — memorable? | **Yes** — a night photograph of Seoul, "Your next chapter is in Korea." and the tangerine button; the closing rising sun repeats the brand device. The hero photo is licensed stock-quality editorial photography, not Hangyul's own — commissioned photography would make it unmistakably Hangyul. |

Reading the numbers honestly: one pill and one small-text node on every after-screen are the dev-only DEV chip; the rest of "text < 12 px" are avatar initials and badge digits (no body text below 12 px — checked node by node). The home is **longer** by design (photography, journey, product, universities, life — 4.1 → 7.8 screens at 1728, 8.3 → 10.9 at 390) after one reduction pass removed Guides (10.3 → 9.6 at 1440). The applicant page is longer because it now includes the statements reader and academic record (section jump links at the top). Dev-server load times are noisy (HMR, concurrent agents) — the production measurements are below.

**Production performance (vite build, `vite preview`, throttled ~9 Mbps / 150 ms, 4× CPU on phone):** marketing home LCP **2.07 s phone / 1.66 s desktop**, FCP 1.96 / 1.45 s; hero image 345 KB desktop / 91 KB phone. Initial JS per app 190–205 KB gzip (V3: ≈ 155–170 KB) + CSS 32–40 KB.

**Task clicks (before → after):** visitor eligibility check: 1 select + 2 chip groups + level select + button (5–6 interactions, card below the fold on some phones) → 3 selects + 1 button, fully in the first viewport at 390×844. Testing as another persona: sign out → type email + password from a list (≈ 6 actions) → 2 clicks (DEV chip → persona), cross-product in 2 clicks via hand-off. Reviewer: approve → next essay: 3 clicks (approve, confirm, back to queue, open next) → `A` + Enter (next essay opens automatically). Student accepting a suggestion: copy text by hand → one tap ("Accept").

YNEX: the default vertical layout with the navy `#111c43` menu, HRM/CRM/Jobs dashboards (stat cards with tinted icon avatars and top rules, dated "upcoming events" timeline, progress tables), `crm-contacts` table, `file-manager` and `mail` three-pane layouts, `task-kanban-board`, `task-list-view`, `profile`/`job-candidate-details` headers, `timeline`, `form_layout`.

**Do not use (documented in the inventories):** Eduan teachers, testimonials, partner-logo strips and counters with invented numbers (no real people, partners or outcomes to show — V6 honesty rules), Font Awesome Pro, Magnific video, the info top-bar; YNEX crypto/NFT/ecommerce/stocks dashboards, switcher, cart, apps grid, fullscreen, icon fonts, ApexCharts/ECharts/DataTables/FullCalendar runtimes (styling reproduced on Recharts and React instead).

**Licensing note.** The owner authorised use of both packages. YNEX credits its photos to Unsplash. Eduan's documentation lists no image sources, so Eduan photographs are used only as generic "students studying" moments, never captioned as Hangyul students, staff or partner campuses, and never to stand for Korea (they show European-style campuses); the `/credits` page says so. All Korea imagery remains Hangyul's licensed CC0/CC BY photography.

## 41.4 Adapter architecture

```
packages/eduan-ui/   src/scss/eduan/ (verbatim Eduan SCSS, 2 documented edits) · _bootstrap-subset.scss · _hangyul.scss (theme values) ·
                     _hangyul-glue.scss (ed-* glue, element rules re-scoped to .ed, RTL, a11y, phones) · eduan.scss / site.scss entries
                     src/components/ primitives.tsx (Ticker, Reveal, SectionTitle, Offcanvas, useStickyHeader, arrows) · icons.tsx (Eduan line icons)
packages/ynex-ui/    src/scss/ynex/ (verbatim YNEX SCSS) · ynex.scss (Bootstrap 5.3.3 subset + YNEX partials used) · _hangyul.scss (theme) ·
                     _hangyul-skin.scss (hg-* → YNEX, shell glue, AA tints) · skin.scss entry (loaded after @hangyul/ui)
                     src/components/ Shell.tsx (YnexShell) · blocks.tsx (PageHeader, YCard, StatCard, DateTimeline, ProgressRow, YTabs, SoftBadge, SplitPane, Row/Col, AvatarList)
packages/config/vite.ts  SCSS (modern compiler, template deprecations silenced) · PostCSS: rtlcss for Eduan, PurgeCSS for template + legacy marketing CSS in builds
```
Load order per app: template CSS → `@hangyul/ui` base → app CSS → template glue/skin. Template element rules that the shared base resets are re-declared under `:where(.ed)` (specificity 0,0,1) so Eduan's typography survives without beating any Eduan class rule.

# 42. V7 Product Re-Audit

*Ruthless pass on the running product (V6 state), before and during the rebuild. Earlier "Done / Pass / Premium" claims were ignored.*

**Student (a 19-year-old from Nepal, phone, limited English).** Finds a university: yes — but V6 discovery was hairline rows; now program cards show city, deadline, language and first-year cost on the card. Understands why they qualify: on marketing only the four requirements are visible without a profile; the program page now says plainly that fit depends on those four and offers the 30-second check or sign-in (no probability). Understands money: V6 showed tuition per semester in places and a first-year range elsewhere; the home and program page now show the same first-year composition (2 semesters + fee + 12 months living) with its checked date and "tuition is paid to the university". Apostille: each program's document list marks "Apostille or consular" per document and links to the guide. Writing help, submission, visa, housing, arrival: present since V5/V6 and now told as one dated four-step journey on the home. A parent could follow the home without an account (place → check → programs → cost → journey). Remaining confusion: the program page cannot show the personal match without sign-in (by design), and most copy beyond en/ko is machine draft.

**Agency (200 students).** Today now answers "who needs me now" with five drill-down counts before the queue; Students keeps saved views, filters, column config and bulk actions in a YNEX table; review screens are three-pane. What still forces work outside Hangyul: external messaging channels (KakaoTalk, WhatsApp, email) are modelled but not integrated; calendar sync for consultations doesn't exist; bulk document download/export per student is limited. These are listed in §46.

**University (1,000 applicants).** The decision queue, applicant table and reader view existed; credibility in front of a director depended on visual weight, which the YNEX navy shell provides. Data trust: metrics keep definitions, n and n<5 withholding. Missing for scale: SSO, scheduled exports, bulk decisions (§46).

**Hangyul operations.** `/hq` answered "what is at risk" in V6 as four text columns; V7 adds a stat strip where every number opens exactly those records (one exception documented: agencies with SLA breaches scroll to the agency table because no list with that rule exists).

**Functional gaps re-checked from §39 (locally solvable without fake integrations):** demo seed consistency (dev DB still not resettable by policy — unchanged); translation gaps (V7 marketing copy machine-drafted into all locales in this pass); server/client type drift (unchanged, §46); payload (CSS purge added, §44); native consistency (unchanged); legal workflow and user testing (unchanged, §46).

## 43.2 Adapter packages and build pipeline (coordinator)
- `packages/ynex-ui`: YNEX SCSS copied verbatim (licence header intact); `ynex.scss` compiles Bootstrap 5.3.3 (the version YNEX v4.1 ships) — only the modules used — then YNEX's variables, switcher (menu-colour rules), 19 Bootstrap overrides it needs, custom/dashboard/header/widgets/auth, vertical + icon-overlay menu styles, chat/file-manager/mail/task pages, utilities; `_hangyul.scss` changes values only (cobalt through `--primary-rgb`, AA muted text, Pretendard, Montserrat 500/600 self-hosted Latin subset, visible focus); `_hangyul-skin.scss` maps every shared `hg-*` component to YNEX anatomy (card radius/shadow/accent-bar title, table heads, buttons, soft badges, inputs, tabs, page header), the React shell glue and the AA overrides for YNEX's tinted badges/avatars. React: `YnexShell` (port of sidebar.html + header.html + _vertical.scss; `<html data-nav-layout|data-menu-styles|data-toggled…>` driven by React state; collapse = icon-overlay rail with hover expansion; phones = off-canvas with `inert` when closed and Escape), `PageHeader`, `YCard`, `StatCard`, `DateTimeline`, `ProgressRow`, `YTabs` (roving focus), `SoftBadge`, `SplitPane`, `Row`/`Col`, `AvatarList`. Both console apps load YNEX CSS → `@hangyul/ui` → YNEX skin → app CSS; `AppLayout` swaps `ConsoleShell` for `YnexShell` (same props).
- `packages/eduan-ui`: Eduan SCSS copied verbatim with two documented edits (font variable → Pretendard; Google Fonts import removed); `eduan.scss` = Bootstrap subset (reboot, grid, helpers, utilities) + all Eduan partials + `_hangyul.scss` (tangerine for Eduan's red, charcoal-night for its purple, visible focus, reduced motion). `site.scss` → `_hangyul-glue.scss` (loaded after the shared base): Eduan element rules re-declared under `:where(.ed)`; `text-transform: capitalize` disabled; React-port styles (ticker, reveal, sticky header, offcanvas, typewriter); all Hangyul content glue (`ed-*`); phone compositions; tall-script typography; AA fixes; RTL gradient mirroring. React: `Ticker` (bxSlider ticker → CSS marquee), `Reveal` (WOW → IntersectionObserver), `useStickyHeader`, `Offcanvas` (MeanMenu → focus-trapped dialog), `SectionTitle`, arrow glyphs, `EduanIcon` (Eduan's own line icons, extracted from index-6/7).
- `packages/config/vite.ts`: SCSS (modern compiler, `node_modules` load path, template deprecations silenced); PostCSS plugin applied only to template CSS: `postcss-rtlcss` for Eduan (physical → `[dir]` pairs) and, in production builds, PurgeCSS over all app/package sources with runtime class patterns safelisted and runtime attributes declared (`dir`, `lang`, layout `data-*`, `aria-*`). The first safelist was too broad (kept every RTL rule; 724 → 549 KB); narrowed to runtime-built classes only (724 → 106 KB). The V6 marketing stylesheets (`styles.css`, `v6.css`) are purged the same way.

## 47.4 Top problems (ranked)

1. Early students are told they qualify for nothing (missing data shown as failure).
2. Marketing home is long and abstract — it explains, three times, instead of showing the product.
3. Tables scroll sideways at laptop/tablet widths in 21 views.
4. Student navigation does not follow the journey stage.
5. University analytics cannot drill down under filters and takes 25 s to load.
6. Applicant review grew to 5.1 screens; decision evidence is not side by side.
7. Agency Today lists queues, not priorities with reasons.
8. Secondary console pages leak enums, JSON and IDs (audit, notifications) and duplicate each other (deadlines/tasks, pipeline/applicants).
9. HQ shows equal-weight counts twice, not where the ecosystem is failing.
10. Manager questions (backlog growth, ageing, overload, slow stages) have no screen.
11. Messages have no channel model in the UI — every external conversation leaves Hangyul.
12. Exports are a list of buttons; no presets, no configuration.
13. E2E depends on stale dev personas (3 skips).
14. Marketing trust page is 17 phone screens.
15. Student compare and budget have no primary action.
16. Programs & rules opens on a development fixture.
17. Documentation contradicts the product (PRODUCT.md template/licence section).
18. Locale coverage is 46 (12 with the student namespace); no review status beyond MACHINE_DRAFT.
19. Design drift: student app loads four generations of CSS (`styles`, `v2`, `v4`, `v7`), consoles keep their V2–V6 stylesheets under the YNEX skin.
20. Console CSS grew ~20 KB gzip in V7; university Analytics is slow; no CSS reduction since.

# 48. V8 Competitive Benchmark

Fresh research (40 references, accessed 2026-10-09) is the new top section of `docs/COMPETITOR_BENCHMARK.md` ("V8 benchmark"). The bars Hangyul must beat, task by task:

| Task | Best current reference | Bar for Hangyul |
|---|---|---|
| Discovery & eligibility | IDP FastLane (no-documents eligibility, explicitly not an offer) | Instant result before an account; never treat missing data as "not eligible"; show post-admission language conditions where published |
| Cost | Wise / Airbnb all-in price | One first-year total on every card; every line with payee, basis and source date; lines that add up |
| Do-it-yourself vs assisted | VisaHQ (fee split), HigherVisa vs HiKorea | Show the official fee separately from Hangyul's fee; say when the student can do it themselves |
| Application status | Wise transfer tracking | Evidence per step; "submitted" ≠ "received" wording |
| Writing review | (none good; ApplyBoard SoP generator is the anti-pattern) | Rubric, versions, authorship statement, AI never writes |
| University review | Slate Reader | Stage separate from assignment; review-and-advance in one action; evidence beside the requirement |
| Agency caseload | Attio / Linear saved views | Per-person views, bulk with preview, no sideways tables |
| Analytics | Stripe dashboard | Chart → exact list → record, totals that match, stated definitions |
| Arrival | University Living ("No visa, no pay") | Refund/visa-refusal terms on every booking; one record reused across pickup, housing, SIM, residence card |

Do not copy: unexplained success rates, fake urgency, hidden fees, AI scoring of student credibility, unexplained "verified" badges, paid peer posts without a label.

# 49. V8 Product Simplification Strategy

**Rule: fewer decisions, fewer repeats, fewer pages — better outcomes.** V8 adds only what removes work elsewhere.

| Remove / merge | Replaced by |
|---|---|
| Marketing: "Why Hangyul" icon grid, "Admission success" rows, two cost panels, life triptych, guides on home | One "Hangyul at work" section of four concrete product moments (eligibility gap, reused document, reviewer comment, visa document); journey + life in Korea as one photographic journey; cost explained once on How it works; guides in nav/footer |
| Student `/saved`, `/support` | Discovery "Saved" tab; one Help page |
| Student fixed navigation | Stage-aware primary navigation (same five slots, different destinations by stage) |
| Agency Deadlines, Consultations as modules | Tasks views (Deadlines, Meetings) + workspace meetings |
| University Pipeline as a page | Applicants board view |
| University `/rules` | Programs & rules |
| HQ seven cards + four columns of the same counts | One severity-ordered list of failures with drill-downs + per-agency table |
| Readiness % anywhere in consoles | "N items remain" |
| Sideways-scrolling tables | Column priority by container width + row detail |
| Four generations of student CSS; V2–V6 console CSS under the skin | Dead-selector removal; one layered stylesheet per app |

What V8 adds (each closes a measured gap): missing-data-aware eligibility presentation; explainable agency priority (reasons, no score); operational saved views; manager view; message channel model (in-app live, external adapters shown as not connected); safe university bulk actions (assign reviewer, request a standard document, export, mark administrative check); applications API `intake` and `degree` filters for exact drill-down; export presets; production-readiness page; deterministic E2E database; locale expansion with honest review statuses; research protocols for real user tests.

# 50. V8 UX & Information Architecture

**Marketing home (target ≈ 8 phone screens):** Desire (hero, one action) → Personal possibility (the check — progressive on phones, remembers prior answers locally) → Real programs (nearest deadlines, first-year cost) → Hangyul at work (four concrete product moments) → The journey to Korea (application → admission → visa → arrival & first weeks, photographic) → Trust (sourced numbers, responsibility statements) → Start (closing band) → compact footer (accordion columns on phones).

**Student primary navigation by stage** (five slots; Messages always last):

| Stage | Slots |
|---|---|
| Exploring / profile | Home · Universities · Saved & compare (Discovery tab) · Documents · Messages |
| Preparing / applied | Home · Applications · Documents · Universities · Messages |
| Admitted / visa | Home · Applications (offer) · Visa · Documents · Messages |
| Visa issued / arrived | Home · Arrival · Housing · Help · Messages |

**Student home:** stage band (compact on phones) → the one next step with its action fully in the first viewport → stage-specific secondary (exploring: closest programs; preparing: applications; admitted: offer amounts; visa/arrival: checklist) → coming up → your counselor.

**Discovery result priority:** University · Program · eligibility state in words (meets the published requirements / exact gap / "we need your grades to check") · first-year cost · deadline · language · city; reasons on demand.

**Agency:** Today = "Who needs me now" — one ranked list of work items, each with the reason it ranks ("Deadline in 2 days · documents missing", "Student waiting 4 days") and an action; then deadlines-at-risk, team load. Students = column priority (≥1280 all; 1024 Student · Stage · Waiting on · Next action · Deadline; ≤768 rows), views: My urgent, Deadline < 7 days, Waiting on student > 3 days, Waiting on university, Document correction, Visa blocked, New paid, Unassigned. Manager view (Performance): backlog trend, case ageing by stage, counselor load vs capacity, SLA failures, stage durations — each with drill-down.

**University:** Overview = Needs a decision → This intake's progress; lifecycle moves to Analytics. Applicants = Applicant · Program · Country · Status · Documents · Decision need · Updated (priority order), board view toggle, safe bulk actions. Applicant review = requirement | applicant evidence | status table first, documents and statements as evidence, decision panel. Analytics = every bar/row drills down to the exact applicants with the same filters; totals match.

**Hangyul operations:** "Where is the ecosystem failing?" — severity-ordered failure list (SLA breaches, blocked submissions, visa blockers, university requests waiting, overloaded agencies, stale sources, service failures, payment issues), per-agency table, production-readiness page (integrations: configured / not configured / needs agreement).

**Consistency contract:** STATE_MAP gains the cross-product names for "waiting" states and the eligibility vocabulary including "we need your … to check".

Side-by-side images are in `docs/qa/v8/comparisons/`. Task figures are scripted walkthroughs by the build team: click counts and measured loads, **not observed user times**. No human participated in any V8 test (protocols: `docs/research/v8-*.md`).*

| Measure (247 views) | V7 | V8 |
|---|---|---|
| Tables scrolling sideways | 21 | 3 (university, 390 px only) |
| Views with h1 ≠ 1 | 8 | 0 |
| Page overflow | 0 | 0 (also 0 at 320/768/1728 for marketing and student, 150 views) |

**Tasks (scripted)**

| Task | V7 | V8 |
