# 301. V24 University Media & Discovery Results

Measured by `scripts/qa/v24/media-coverage.mjs` against the served API; the CSV is
`docs/qa/v24/UNIVERSITY_MEDIA_COVERAGE.csv` (425 rows, Part J columns plus `issues`).

| Primary visual | V23 | V24 |
|---|--:|--:|
| Campus photographs | 151 | **155** |
| Official photographic imagery (institution-published, licensed for this use) | 0 | **0** |
| Official video-led | 79 | **76** |
| Logo-led | 3 | **2** |
| Designed identity fallback | 192 | **192** |

- **Fallback is unchanged at 192, and every one of those institutions has a logged search.** The record is in
  `server/app/data/raw/v24_media_candidates.json`. The routes were:
  - Commons with Wikidata aliases and three category levels.
  - Openverse (507 queries).
  - KOGL Type 1 on the 13 national/public sites.
  - 공유마당.
- Official university sites were read for an open licence. None of the private institutions publishes campus photographs
  under terms that allow rehosting, so nothing was copied from them.
- The sweep produced 22 candidates for 12 institutions; 4 passed my visual and size review:
  - University of Suwon: logo-led → photo, hero plus 3 gallery images.
  - Catholic University of Pusan, Sahmyook and KDI School: film-led → photo; the film stays on the page.
- Rejected:
  - Yeungnam: a dark portrait, plus two 1971 archive photos whose 공유마당 and Commons licences disagree.
  - Hanyeong: blurred, wires in front.
  - Keimyung, PNU and Daelim: portrait crops; Keimyung and PNU had also been rejected by a person in V21.
  - Sun Moon: fisheye.
  - Daekyeung (889 px) and Induk (800 px): too small for a full-bleed hero.
- **The 47 공유마당 KOGL-1 leads** (Hanseo 16, Semyung 10, Namseoul 8, …) serve only a placeholder. Their originals sit
  behind a robots.txt that blocks automated agents. A person can download them through 공유마당's own button, and that is
  the most promising route to reduce the fallback further.

**The 151 existing photographs, re-scored.**
- All heroes were viewed cropped at their focal point. 51 were weak on the 10 criteria (§293).
- 19 were replaced from their own licensed galleries. Yonsei (five Sinchon photographs replacing an all-Wonju set) and
  KAIST (the campus pond from above) got new sources.
- 1 focal point was moved (Incheon, away from a railing). Every swapped hero was re-checked at 16:10 and 4:5 on
  `docs/qa/v24/photo-review/swapped-focal.jpg`.
- **30 heroes remain weak-but-truthful.** The CSV marks them `quality_score = weak`; examples are kosin, seowon, sunchon,
  sungsan-hyo, woosuk, yuhan, dongnam-health, osan, shingu and SNUE. Commons holds nothing better for them; V22's sweep
  found 1–4 photos each, all already in use.
- Kookmin keeps its street-view hero; its two "gallery" images were cats and are gone.

**Integrity.**
- Every hero and gallery file exists at 640 and 1200 in both apps.
- Every photograph carries licence, source URL, author, `verified_at` and `local_path`. Hand-picked ones also carry
  `quality_score`, `source_owner` and `license_url`.
- No source file is used by two institutions. The two "shared" hits were the literal string "Wikimedia Commons", now
  replaced by exact URLs.
- The CSV check reports 0 defects.

# 310. V25 Independent Product Audit

Written 2026-10-27, **before any V25 product change**. Evidence: BEFORE captures of 35 routes at 390 / 430 / 768 / 1024 / 1440
(+1728 for the two consoles) in Korean, `docs/qa/v25/visual/before/<group>/<route>-<width>.png`, made by
`scripts/qa/v25/capture.mjs` against the running stack; the V24 media CSV (`docs/qa/v24/UNIVERSITY_MEDIA_COVERAGE.csv`,
snapshotted as `docs/qa/v25/_coverage_before.json`) and the code. I judged the screenshots as a first-time visitor and as the
owner, not against V24's own conclusions — the brief rejects V24's "calm design is fine", "keep the agency workspace",
"analytics already good" and "425/425 intentional" verdicts, and I re-opened each.

**Overall verdict.** Hangyul Univ is a correct product that still *looks like software*. Every surface is truthful and the
workflows exist, but the visual language is the residue of 24 passes layered on each other: marketing has eight stacked
stylesheets (`v6 … v24.css`), every action is a pill, the student app is lists of hairline rows with letter tiles where
universities should be, and the university directory — the thing a student browses to fall in love with a place — shows a
real photograph on only **155 of 425** cards. Of the other 270, 76 show a YouTube promotional poster (text overlays such as
"그래도 돼", "7년연속 취업률 1위", posed models), 192 a dark navy province map with the name typeset on it, and 2 a logo.

The ten problems that matter most, in order of user impact:

| # | Problem | Where |
|--:|---|---|
| P1 | 270 / 425 universities have no real photograph; 76 of them lead with ad-like video posters, 192 with a dark map | directory, detail, student app |
| P2 | The student-side university page has **no photography at all** (letter tile + data tables) — a worse second directory | student `/universities/:slug`, `/explore` |
| P3 | Universities are represented by coloured letter squares (`UniMark`) in every student list, even where a licensed photo exists | student home, applications, explore |
| P4 | Every CTA is a 999-px pill; "대학 전체 보기" floats alone 80 px under the marquee with a decorative arrow bubble | marketing |
| P5 | Student home reads as a dashboard: six stacked list sections, red/amber text, the next action is a small square button | student `/` |
| P6 | The detail page's middle reads as records ("공시 학과 수 10개", "공식 정보 확인일", a one-row "학교에 직접 확인하기") | marketing detail |
| P7 | 137 of the 155 photographs need attribution; the credit pill on the picture is heavy and repeated on every card | directory |
| P8 | Agency and University homes (see §314–§315) | consoles |
| P9 | Design tokens exist (`--hg-type-*`) but radius/shadow/button rules differ per product; marketing has no shared button scale with student | all |
| P10 | REPORT §0 still says V23; V24's §302–§309 were never written | docs |

Each is written below in the brief's form. The per-area sections (§311–§317) carry the detail.

**P1 · Most universities have no real photograph.**
CURRENT STATE: 155 campus photographs, 76 official-film-led, 2 logo-led, 192 designed identity (V24 CSV).
WHAT THE USER SEES: in the first 16 cards of the directory, 6 are film posters (one a girl in a hoodie under "그래도 돼"), 1 a
navy map, 9 photographs. On a phone it is one card per screen, so the first impression is often an advert.
WHY IT FEELS BAD: the directory is the emotional heart of the public site; a placeholder or an advert says "we know nothing
about this place".
USER IMPACT: fewer detail views, less trust, less "I can imagine studying here".
ROOT CAUSE: V22–V24 searched Commons by *name* (categories, aliases, full text) and Openverse. They never asked for photographs
*located on the campus* (geotagged files named after a building or a date), nor for the images editors placed inside each
institution's Wikipedia article. The 47 공유마당 leads were left unprocessed.
REDESIGN: photo-first; real photography is the success metric, not "intentional visual".
IMPLEMENTATION: (1) Commons **geosearch** inside a radius of each campus (Wikidata P625, else OSM Nominatim for the Korean
name); (2) images used in the ko/en Wikipedia article; (3) the 공유마당 leads processed as far as robots.txt permits, the rest
written up as an exact manual action; (4) every candidate viewed by me on a contact sheet before import; (5) the per-row search
record `UNIVERSITY_PHOTO_SEARCH.csv`.
VALIDATION: `qa:v25` photo coverage, rights metadata, cross-university reuse = 0, file/rendition existence, focal data.

**P2 · The student app's university page has no photograph.**
CURRENT: `/universities/pusan-national-university` in the student app opens on a small crest, a program select and a white
card of numbers; below it a tab bar of tables.
SEES: an ERP record for a city they may move to.
WHY BAD: the public site shows the same university with a full-bleed campus photograph; signing in makes it *worse*.
IMPACT: the moment a student is closest to committing, the product loses its warmth.
ROOT CAUSE: the student page predates the V21–V24 public media system and never adopted `UniversityHero` / the gallery.
REDESIGN: share the public media system (photo, focal point, gallery, identity) and lay the student's match/apply panel over it.
IMPLEMENTATION: the student university API serialiser carries the institution's media (hero, gallery, focal points) via
`institutions.catalog_university_id`; the page opens with the shared hero and a gallery block.
VALIDATION: rendered check that a catalogue university with a photo shows `<img>` in the student hero; screenshots.

**P3 · Letter tiles stand in for universities.** `UniMark` draws "P", "K" squares in brand colours on home, applications and
explore — rainbow chips, the opposite of photography. REDESIGN: a 56–72 px photo thumbnail (the institution's hero at 640 px,
focal-cropped) with the letter tile only when no photo exists. VALIDATION: screenshot review; no `UniMark` where a photo exists.

**P4 · Pill CTAs everywhere** — §311.  **P5 · Student home** — §313.  **P6 · Detail page** — §312.  **P7 · Credits** — §312.

**P10 · Documentation drift.** REPORT §0 is headed "V23 — 2026-10-25" and still lists 151/79/3/192 media; V24 appended
§290–§301 and stopped. §0 also contains a duplicated, orphaned table fragment ("---|---| Web (marketing, student) | Running…")
left by an earlier edit. PRODUCT.md still prices plans at ₩249,000/₩499,000/₩849,000 (USD since V17). REDESIGN: rewrite §0
for V25 from the running system; fix current-state docs; leave dated sections as history.

# 311. V25 Marketing & Conversion Audit

Screens: `/` at all widths, `/universities`, three detail pages, `/start`.

**M1 · Every action is a pill.** CURRENT: header "유학 준비 →", hero "내 유학 준비 →" + "대학 둘러보기", plan CTAs, the compare
toggle, the closing band — all `border-radius: 999px` (`koreanasha.scss:187`). SEES: generic SaaS buttons; on the dark closing
band two pills next to a decorative tangerine quarter-circle. WHY BAD: a pill is a tag shape; when everything is one, nothing
reads as the editorial voice the photography sets. ROOT CAUSE: Koreanasha's `.btn-blue` (radius 60) was ported verbatim in V10
and every later pass tuned colours, not shape. REDESIGN: one editorial button — soft rectangle, 10 px radius, 52 px (56 px lg),
600 weight, 16–17 px. Pills only for chips/selectors. IMPLEMENTATION: `.kn-btn` base in `koreanasha.scss`, re-declared roles in a
new `v25.css`. VALIDATION: qa:v25 CTA hierarchy check reads computed radius/fill/colour of every marketing action.

**M2 · "대학 전체 보기" is detached.** CURRENT: a 52 px outline pill with a tinted circular arrow well, centred ~80 px below the
third marquee row and ~180 px above the next heading. SEES: a lone object floating between sections. WHY BAD: it belongs to
neither the logos nor the next section; the arrow bubble reads as decoration. REDESIGN: it moves *into* the section: on desktop
it sits in the section's header line, right-aligned to the heading, as a secondary with an inline →; on phones it sits directly
under the marquee at full width. No circular well. IMPLEMENTATION: `pages/home/v11.tsx` university band markup + v25.css.
VALIDATION: 390 / 768 / 1440 screenshots; qa:v25 asserts it is inside the band's header (≥ 768) and ≤ 32 px below the marquee
on phones, unfilled, ≥ 48 px tall, href `/universities`.

**M3 · Secondary actions are weak.** `--outline` is white with a 1 px #9B9EA4-ish border; on the plan cards the two outer CTAs
look like form fields. REDESIGN: SECONDARY = warm-neutral filled surface (#F2EFEB, ink text, no border) on light; translucent
dark + white hairline on photographs. Visible on white without looking like an input.

**M4 · Plan comparison disclosure.** CURRENT: a grey pill "플랜 자세히 비교하기" with a 34 px white chevron disc, 60 px under the
cards. SEES: better than V23's hairline row, but still a floating pill unrelated to the cards. REDESIGN: a full-width disclosure
*bar attached to the plan grid* (same width as the three cards, 56 px, hairline top, label + chevron together at the centre),
reading "플랜 자세히 비교하기 ⌄" / "비교 닫기 ⌃"; the table animates open with `grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr` (instant under
reduced motion). Native `<details>` kept for keyboard semantics. VALIDATION: keyboard open/close + `aria-expanded` in qa:v25.

**M5 · Closing band decoration.** The tangerine quarter-circle in the corner of the dark band is a template ornament; with the
primary also tangerine, the eye splits between them. REMOVE the ornament; keep the band.

**M6 · Arrow semantics.** Mostly fixed in V24 (→ in-product, ↗ external). The detail hero's "공식 홈페이지" uses a box-arrow icon
(`ExternalLink`) while the brief asks for ↗; the student app uses `ChevronRight` (›) as a forward arrow in some links and `→`
in others. REDESIGN: forward = →, external = ↗, back = ←, disclosure = chevron (open/close only).

**M7 · Hero.** KEEP the photograph and headline (strong). The secondary "대학 둘러보기" on the photo is a translucent outline pill;
it becomes the on-photo secondary (soft rectangle) at equal height.

Conversion path measured on the BEFORE stack (anonymous): home → 내 유학 준비 → `/start` (3 questions) → result → "Save these
results" → `/login?next=…` → 회원가입 (4 steps) → `/explore?tab=foryou`. 3 + 4 screens of form, then the plan page is reached
only from the student app's menu. Selected university, locale and the chosen plan survive (`planAction()` →
`/services?plan=<code>`, read by `readPlanParam` since V18 — I checked the code before writing this, because my first reading of
the screens said otherwise). KEEP; qa:v25 re-proves plan and locale preservation through login and scroll-to-top on every
navigation.

# 312. V25 University Discovery Audit

**Baseline (measured, V24 CSV).** 425 institutions · real photograph 155 · film-led 76 · logo-led 2 · identity 192 · weak heroes
30 · of the 155: CC BY-SA 121, CC BY 15, CC0/PD 19 (incl. 1 KOGL-1). Gallery images: on 104 institutions.

**D1 · Coverage** — P1 above.

**D2 · Film posters as card images.** 76 cards use the YouTube poster. Many are promotional title cards (large Korean slogans,
"1위" claims, presenters). WHY BAD: next to campus photographs they read as ads, and a ranking claim printed inside a poster is
shown without context. REDESIGN: a poster may lead a card only when, viewed by a person, it is a **campus scene** without
dominant text; every other film-led institution gets the redesigned identity card until a photograph exists (the film stays on
the detail page). The classification is recorded per institution.

**D3 · The identity fallback looks like a placeholder.** A dark navy rectangle with the province shape in tangerine and the
English name in white — dark, cold, and identical in structure for 192 cards. REDESIGN: a light, typographic composition — warm
cream ground, the Korean name set large in ink, the English name and city beneath, a fine-line province outline in the corner,
the institution's own crest when one is servable. Still clearly *not* a photograph (the brief forbids pretending), but designed,
light and calm in a grid of photographs.

**D4 · Card anatomy.** Image 16:10, name, other-script name, "region · type". Fine in principle. Problems: the credit pill
("가천 · CC BY-SA 4.0") sits on top of the picture in a black box on 137 cards; the hover does nothing but change cursor; the
image is not focal-positioned for the 16:10 crop except where V24 hand-moved six. REDESIGN: credit becomes a 10.5 px line inside
a soft bottom gradient (still visible, still attached to the image, as CC BY requires), image hover scale 1.015 and an arrow that
moves 3 px, pressed state, focus ring on the card, per-image focal point used at every crop.

**D5 · Detail page middle.** "학과와 캠퍼스" can be a single row ("공시 학과 수 10개") plus "공식 정보 확인일"; "학교에 직접 확인하기"
repeats the hero's 공식 홈페이지 link; "캠퍼스가 있는 곳" for Seoul universities is a generic paragraph about Seoul. REDESIGN per
brief §15: HERO → WHY THIS UNIVERSITY → CAMPUS gallery → ACADEMIC IDENTITY (philosophy + programmes count + campuses, as one
block) → INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS → LIFE AROUND CAMPUS → OFFICIAL VIDEO → NEXT STEP. Sections with nothing verified are omitted;
the "official links" block folds into the hero/international section; record-keeping dates move into small print.

**D6 · Hero darkness.** The detail hero applies a heavy ink scrim over the whole photograph (Yonsei reads almost night). REDESIGN:
a directional gradient only behind the text column; the rest of the photo at full light.

**D7 · Weak and wrong photographs.** V24 left 30 weak heroes. Also found in this audit: Ajou's gallery contains
"Ajou University Tashkent" — a different institution in Uzbekistan; it is removed from Ajou's gallery.

**D8 · Performance.** Directory cards request `-640.jpg` with no WebP/AVIF; detail heroes request 2400 JPEG at 1440. REDESIGN:
WebP renditions at 640/1200/2400 next to the JPEGs, `<picture>` with WebP first, `srcset`/`sizes`, width/height stored per asset,
lazy below the fold.

# 313. V25 Student UX Audit

**S1 · Home is a dashboard.** CURRENT (1440): greeting; a small numbered strip; "다음 할 일" as text + a square orange button;
then 한귤 상담팀이 진행 중인 일 / 확인이 필요한 지원서 / 처리할 서류 / 다가오는 일정 / 상담팀 card — six list sections, two columns.
SEES: a work queue. Red "2일 남음", amber "19일 남음", letter tiles, a team card with an orange "읽지 않은 메시지 2개" chip.
WHY BAD: the brief's three questions (where am I / what now / what is Hangyul doing) are answered, but at equal visual weight
with four other lists; nothing is emotional; the next action does not dominate. REDESIGN: (1) a refined journey — a single
progress line with six nodes (done = quiet ink check, current = tangerine node with a halo and label, future = grey), the
current stage's one-sentence summary beneath; (2) the NEXT ACTION as the page's hero: a warm-white panel with the target
university's campus photograph on one side, eyebrow (due), title, why, one large primary; (3) "한귤 팀이 하고 있는 일" as a
quiet two-to-three-line list with the team mark; (4) "내 지원" as photo rows (thumbnail, university, programme, stage in words,
deadline) — no status colours except real urgency (≤ 3 days); (5) 다가오는 일정 as a slim date list in the side column; documents
collapse into the application rows and the documents page (no separate list on home unless something must be fixed).
VALIDATION: screenshot review; qa:v25 asserts exactly one primary button in the home's first viewport.

**S2 · Journey strip.** It works as navigation chrome (pills with numbers and chevrons). REDESIGN as above: progression, not tabs.

**S3 · Letter tiles** — P3.

**S4 · Application detail.** The three lanes (나 / 한귤 상담팀 / 대학) exist since V4 but are drawn as three bordered boxes with
red "!" bullets and amber sentences; the next-action box has a tangerine left border and a square button. REDESIGN: the
application header gets the university photograph as a banner; lanes become three columns separated by space and headed
"내가 할 일 / 한귤이 하는 일 / 대학이 확인하는 일" with plain rows; urgency only by a date chip.

**S5 · Documents.** Requirement-first already (직접 해야 할 일 → 확인 중 → 준비 완료). Visual noise: each group is a bordered card
of rows with small outline buttons. REDESIGN: rows without boxes, the action as a tertiary with →, "아포스티유 필요" as a quiet
tag. The counselor's English note ("The transcript needs an apostille…") is user content and stays as written.

**S6 · Explore.** 66 dense two-line program rows with letter tiles. REDESIGN: university photo thumbnails; the row keeps its data.

**S7 · Student university page** — P2.

**S8 · Essay review.** KEEP: serif 68ch reading column, comments as cards, suggestions with strike/insert. Polish only: the review
header's yellow/blue info boxes become one quiet status line. Rule preserved: humans review; checks never write.

**S9 · Mobile.** Bottom bar 홈·대학·지원 현황·메시지·내 여정 (correct per brief). Pages are the desktop lists stacked; the next-action
button is full width (good). The redesigned home must be designed for 390 first (photo above the next action, not beside).

# 314. V25 Agency UX Audit

Screens: 오늘 `/`, 학생 관리, one student workspace, 지원·서류 review, 메시지, 통계 — 390 → 1728.

**A1 · Today does not say what is urgent.** CURRENT: greeting, date, then the process strip (전체 19 · 신규 0 · 상담 1 · …) and the
work table. The only "today" signal is an orange "14일 내 마감 21건" at the right end of the filter row. SEES: a filtered list, not
a morning brief. WHY BAD: the brief's four questions (who / why / what / when) are answered *per row*, but nothing says "3 things
are overdue, 2 are due today, 5 students are waiting on you" before the eye reaches row 1. IMPACT: the operator scans ten rows to
find the two that matter. ROOT CAUSE: V22 removed the V13 attention cards with the KPI tiles; nothing replaced their *operational*
half. REDESIGN: a single **TODAY line** above the strip — three or four counts phrased as work ("기한 지남 3 · 오늘 마감 2 · 학생이
기다리는 중 5 · 검토 대기 4"), each a link that filters the table (count = rows, from the same server views as the strip).
Zero items disappear. No tiles, no charts. VALIDATION: qa:v25 agency count=row parity for every TODAY item.

**A2 · Process strip.** KEEP the operational strip (V22/V24: count = rows, zero stages dimmed and inert). Polish: selected stage
uses ink text + tangerine underline instead of a tinted orange box; numbers tabular.

**A3 · Table.** 학생 · 현재 단계 · 다음 할 일 · 대기 대상 · 마감 · 대학 · 최근 활동. University names truncate ("Pusan National …") at 1440;
the row is two lines because the flag/country sits under the name. REDESIGN: university column shows the Korean short name
(부산대) when the reader's locale is Korean, with the full name in `title`; deadline column turns red only when overdue/≤ 3 days.

**A4 · The student workspace is orange.** CURRENT: filled tangerine "메시지" + tangerine-tinted "할 일" button, tangerine progress
bar, tangerine e-mail link, tangerine outgoing chat bubbles, tangerine section markers ("처리 필요", "최근 대화"). SEES: an orange
screen. WHY BAD: the brief's agency rule is tangerine only for selection, focus and *the* primary action. REDESIGN: header actions
become one primary (the next action itself, e.g. "학생에게 답장하기") + quiet secondaries; outgoing bubbles ink-on-warm-grey; links
ink; section markers removed; profile progress neutral. Empty "처리 필요" box ("이 학생에 대해 기다리는 일이 없습니다") collapses
to one line.

**A5 · Review (지원·서류).** Three-pane queue → document → checklist works. Orange: filled segmented control and peach selected
row. REDESIGN: neutral segmented control (ink selected), selected row = white with tangerine inline-start rule.

**A6 · Mobile Today.** Three full-width filter selects stacked above the list push the first student below the fold at 390.
REDESIGN: filters behind one "필터" button (bottom sheet), the TODAY line and strip first, then cards.

**A7 · Team identity.** Student-facing identity is "한귤 유니브 상담팀"; agency sees real actors. Verified intact in the workspace
(messages show Trương Mỹ Linh to staff). KEEP — must not regress.

Agency flow simulation (BEFORE, `counselor@lotus`; click counts read from the captured screens and routes, not yet measured by a script — qa:v25 measures them after): new student assigned → first contact = open
Today → row → workspace → message composer (3 clicks + type); documents review = rail 지원·서류 → row → approve (3); essay = 지원·서류 →
에세이 tab → row → comment (4); application ready → submission = workspace → Application tab → submit hand-off (4); university asks
for a document → Today row (reason "대학 요청") → workspace → request item (3). The workspace already holds documents/essay/
conversation/timeline (V11 4 tabs); the extra hop is from Today: the reason column is not itself a link to the item.

# 315. V25 University UX & Analytics Audit

Screens: 지원자 home, applicant review, 통계, 코호트, 유학원, 메시지 — 390 → 1728.

**U1 · Home has no headline.** CURRENT: page title "지원자", "부산대학교 · 지원자 11명", the pipeline strip (전체 11 · 접수 0 · 서류 확인
0 · 심사 중 3 · 보완 요청 2 · 결정 대기 1 · 합격 1 · 등록 1 · 입학 3), filters, table. SEES: a list. The brief's four questions — how
many need action, where in the pipeline, what changed, where next — are answered only by reading the strip. REDESIGN: one compact
**headline row**: "결정이 필요한 지원자 N명" (the number in display size, a link), "이번 주 새 지원 N", "응답 대기 보완 요청 N", "최근
변화" (last 7 days: N moved stage) — four quiet figures, not cards, each a filtered link; then the strip; then the table with
"needs a decision" rows first. VALIDATION: counts = rows in qa:v25.

**U2 · Applicant table.** Good density. Problems: every "업데이트" reads "그저께" (fine, data) and letter avatars repeat the row
colour; "결정에 필요한 것" mixes dots. KEEP structure; remove avatars, keep flag + country, single-line rows.

**U3 · Analytics: five equal charts, no time.** CURRENT: "어디에서 오나요?" (country + agency bars), "어디에서 이탈하나요?" (8-step bar
funnel + "가장 큰 이탈" callout), "어떤 학생이 합격하고 입학하나요?" (3 bars + programme rates), "입학 후 잘 정착하고 있나요?" (cohort
retention bars). SEES: a long scroll of same-weight bar groups. Missing: **any trend over time** ("what changes over time?") and a
headline metric row. WHY BAD: an executive cannot answer "is this term better than last?" REDESIGN per brief §43: one headline
("이번 학기 지원 11건 · 합격 5 · 입학 3"), one concise metric row (submitted, offer rate, enrolment rate, visa issued — each with its
denominator and n<5 honesty), **one primary visualisation** (the application → offer → enrolment funnel with conversion between
steps), one supporting breakdown (country / agency ranked bars, switchable), one trend (monthly submitted applications, a line, from
existing `submitted_at` dates — truthful, no invented data), and the cohort table. Every bar/step/row stays a drill-down
(V22/V23).

**U4 · Visa → enrolment.** The data exists (status history VISA_ISSUED → ENROLLED) but is not shown as its own question. ADD to the
funnel as a step pair with its own conversion, n<5 rule respected.

**U5 · Decision panel.** Filled tangerine "서류 요청" + four outline buttons + red-outline 불합격 stacked: correct hierarchy. KEEP.

**U6 · Mobile.** Table → cards at < 768 (DataTable). The strip scrolls. Acceptable; headline row must stack 2 × 2.

University flow simulation (BEFORE, `admin@pusan`; counts read from the screens and routes): application arrives → strip "접수" → row → review (2) → request document = decision
panel "서류 요청" (1 + form) → interview = "면접 일정 잡기" (1) → offer = "합격 통보" (1) → visa/enrolment outcome = status advance on the
same page (1) → cohort analytics = rail 통계 → scroll (2). Where it fails: after an action the user lands back on the same applicant
(good, "open next" checkbox exists), but the home never says *what changed since I last looked*.

# 316. V25 Mobile Audit

# 317. V25 Design-System Audit

**Shape.** Marketing `.kn-btn` radius 999; student `.hg-btn` radius 8 (`--hg-radius-md`); consoles YNEX `.btn` 6. Three button
shapes for one brand. Pills are also used for chips, stage strips, plan badges and the compare toggle.

**Colour.** Tangerine appears as: primary fill, focus ring, selected strip item (tinted box), section markers (`|` bars before
console card titles), progress bars, outgoing chat bubbles, e-mail links, the "추천" plan badge, the closing band ornament, red-ish
"2일 남음" (danger red, separate). Rule to enforce: tangerine = primary action, current/selected, focus. Everything else ink/neutral;
semantic colours only for success / warning / danger / blocked.

**Type.** V24 created `--hg-type-*` (display 40 / h1 30 / h2 22 / h3 18 / body 16 / small 14 / caption 12). Marketing still sets
section titles with `clamp()` literals in `v11.css`/`v15.css`; consoles mix 13/14/15 px body. KEEP the scale; apply it to the new V25
layers only through tokens (gate: no literal font-size in V25 CSS).

**Spacing.** Marketing "대학 전체 보기" 80 px gap above, 180 px below; student home sections separated by 40 px and a hairline each;
console cards padded 16–24 px inconsistently. One rhythm: 4-pt base, section 48/72/96, group 24/32, item 12/16.

**Cards.** Student uses bordered panels for lists (applications, documents, checklist lanes) — lists, not objects. Consoles wrap
every block in a YCard with a title bar. Rule: a card only for a self-contained object (a plan, a university, an application
summary); lists are rows on the page.

**Shadows.** Plan card (recommended) carries a resting shadow; student header none; console cards `--hg-shadow-sm`; dropdowns md.
Rule: resting surfaces none; hover-raise and floating (menus, sheets, dialogs, sticky header) only.

**Stylesheet layering.** marketing: 8 version layers; student: 9; agency: 9. V25 adds **one** layer per product (`v25.css`) plus
token changes, and deletes rules it supersedes where they are V24-local (v24.css browse/compare blocks).

# 318. V25 Implementation Plan

Ordered by user impact; one heavy process at a time (§68 of the brief); evidence written to `docs/qa/v25/`.

1. **Media sourcing (highest priority).** Run the two new routes (Commons geosearch at 700 m; images inside the ko/en Wikipedia
   article) over all 270 photo-less institutions; view every candidate on contact sheets; import accepted ones through
   `v24-import-picked.py apply` (licence and author read from Commons, cross-use refused). Write `MANUAL_MEDIA_ACQUISITION.md`
   for the 50 공유마당 leads (robots-blocked originals) and `UNIVERSITY_PHOTO_SEARCH.csv` (per-row record of every route).
2. **Photo re-audit + scores.** Contact sheets of all heroes at 16:10 and 4:5; per-criterion score stored on each hero
   (`quality` object: correctness, beauty, composition, light, resolution, recognition, architecture, crop_desktop, crop_mobile,
   appeal, total); swap weak heroes to better licensed gallery images; remove wrong-institution images (Ajou Tashkent).
3. **Focal points per breakpoint.** `focal_x/focal_y` + optional `focal_mobile_x/y`; components set `--focal-desktop` and
   `--focal-mobile` CSS variables; 16:10 and 4:5 checked on sheets.
4. **Renditions.** WebP 640/1200/2400 beside every JPEG; `<picture>` WebP-first with `srcset`/`sizes`; stored width/height.
5. **Film-poster rule + identity redesign.** Classify the 76 film posters by eye (campus scene vs promo title card); only campus
   scenes lead a card. New light identity card for the rest.
6. **Directory + detail.** Photo-first card (refined credit line, hover/pressed/focus), detail story order with sparse sections
   merged or omitted, lighter hero scrim, gallery composition, ↗ for official links.
7. **Marketing CTA system.** Soft-rectangle buttons in four roles, "대학 전체 보기" into the section header, the attached compare
   disclosure with animated panel, closing-band ornament removed, header CTA.
8. **Design tokens.** `--hg-radius-control: 10px`, button roles shared by `@hangyul/ui` (`.hg-btn`), YNEX skin and mobile-ui;
   shadow rule; tangerine rule in the consoles.
9. **Student.** Home (journey line, next-action hero with university photo, team-now, application photo rows, date list);
   application header photo + plain lanes; documents rows; explore photo thumbnails; the student university page on the shared
   hero/gallery (API carries institution media).
10. **Agency.** TODAY line (server counts = rows), strip polish, de-oranged workspace, review queue polish, mobile filter sheet.
11. **University.** Headline row on home; analytics restructured (headline, metric row, primary funnel incl. visa → enrolment,
    supporting breakdown, monthly trend, cohort table) — all from existing data, all drill-down.
12. **Copy + i18n.** New strings ko/en written by hand, the other 31 market locales machine-translated with placeholder/tag/
    length/script checks (SYNTHETIC_NATIVE_REVIEWED).
13. **Native.** mobile-ui button radius/roles, student home hierarchy; APK + AAB × 3 rebuilt sequentially if shared mobile code
    changed; iOS attempted only if EAS is authenticated.
14. **`npm run qa:v25`** (static + API + rendered), AFTER captures at the same widths, side-by-side review, 50 random + 30
    regional + all changed + all remaining-fallback institutions viewed.
15. **Docs.** Drift fixes in current-state docs; REPORT §319–§329; §0 rewritten for V25.

# 319. V25 Implementation Log

What changed, in the order of §318, with the deviations stated where they happened. Evidence: `docs/qa/v25/`.

**1 · Media sourcing.** Two routes V22–V24 never ran, plus a re-walk of category trees:
- `scripts/universities/v25-geosearch.mjs` — Commons files **geotagged within 700 m of the campus** (coordinates: Wikidata P625
  for 143 institutions; OSM Nominatim under the Korean name for 58, at ≤ 1 request/s; 69 had no coordinate anywhere). 270
  institutions searched, 1,264 candidates, 335 put on contact sheets (`docs/qa/v25/media-review/geo/`, ranked by title/campus
  vocabulary, ≤ 6 per institution). Yield was low and honest: most geotagged files near a campus are buses, stations, cars,
  shops, political events or a neighbouring school. Accepted: **Halla** (a CC0 walk-through by one photographer: main gate with
  the university's name, atrium, study lounge, brick hall), **Namseoul** (a drone view of the whole campus; description "학교전체
  구도", 241 m from the campus point, no other institution in range), **Hyupsung** (three CC0 frames incl. the name wall).
- `scripts/universities/v25-wikiimages.mjs` — images an editor placed **inside the institution's ko/en Wikipedia article**
  (Commons files only; a file local to Wikipedia is non-free there and was refused). 37 candidates: **Keimyung** (main building,
  hanok village, library, aerial, gate), **GIST** (student union, administration), **Yeungnam** (dormitory over the lake, folk
  village, international student centre, museum, autumn), **Kyungmin** (main building). 24 refused, each with its reason
  (`media-review/wiki/decisions.json`: Haemi Martyrdom shrine ≠ Hanseo, National Assembly ≠ inst-642, banners, people, a logo).

  (34) and for weak majors (9). **Pusan National University had no photograph** before V25; it now leads with its administration
  tower and carries 운죽정, Hyowon, the Miryang and Yangsan campuses (its own). **Gangwon State** (CC0 amphitheatre), **Catholic
  Kwandong** (gymnasium — weak, the only exterior on record), **Kunsan National** (its own training ship, name on the hull).
- `scripts/universities/v25-official-rights.mjs` — the reuse terms each photo-less institution's own homepage states, read once,
  robots.txt honoured: 82 reserve all rights, 38 are silent (= reserved), 66 robots-blocked or unreachable, 72 have no site on

  31 photographs applied (12 heroes, 19 gallery). Log: `docs/qa/v25/media-review/import-log.json`.
- `docs/qa/v25/UNIVERSITY_PHOTO_SEARCH.csv` — 425 rows, every column the brief lists plus `geosearch_v25` and
  `wikipedia_article_v25`, generated by `scripts/universities/v25-photo-search.py` from the raw logs (no hand-typed cell).

# 331. V26 Root-Cause Analysis

The matrix is `docs/qa/v26/ROOT_CAUSE_MATRIX.md` (RC-01…RC-26: first/last seen, evidence, impact, root cause, why QA
missed it, why the previous fix was insufficient, recurrence, severity, proper fix, regression protection) with a verdict
on each of the brief's hypotheses A–R.

Verdicts in one line each: **A proven** (pages assembled from components the API offered), **B proven/open** (9/9/8/5
version stylesheets, 82/151/126/114 provably dead declarations), **C proven** (vendor resets, pills, literal sizes), D partly
(feature count was cut in V11; composition is the complaint now), **E proven, partly mitigated**, **F proven/open** (every
agency row and every "needs action" item opens a page, never the record), **G proven** (university native headline),
**H proven — recurred today**, I partly (STATE_MAP exists; student copy still says "your counselor" in places), **J proven**
(the fallback was redesigned five times while 259 photos stayed missing), K closed in V22, **L proven** (no real users or
translators in 25 passes), M partly (browser zoom never tested), N partly (ruff scope, skips), O partly, P mostly closed in
V25, **Q proven**, **R proven** (2.3 GB `docs/qa`, 93 probe scripts, 1.1 GB `result/`, a 17k-line copy of REPORT).

The causes that matter most, in order of user impact:
1. **Destinations were modelled as pages, not records** (RC-01). The data to route to the exact item exists on the server
   but was never returned. Fix the data contract once (`targets` + `focus=`), not each link.
2. **Gates write on shared seeded data and nothing tears it down** (RC-02). Fix: teardown in the writer + a residue gate.
3. **Every pass adds a stylesheet instead of editing the rule's owner** (RC-03). Fix: consolidate in cascade order, delete
   what is provably shadowed, gate the file names and the shadow count.
4. **Pages model the system's objects, not the user's question** (RC-06/09): Explore lists programmes, Services lists quotas.
5. **Quality is asserted by the builder** (RC-12/13): only external people can close that — protocol prepared.

# 332. V26 Competitive Re-Benchmark

`docs/qa/v26/CURRENT_BENCHMARK.md` — Cialfo, ApplyBoard, Studyportals, Common App, Slate, Element451, Liaison CAS, IDP
FastLane (+ Leverage Edu, Unibuddy), read from official help centres and release notes on 2026-10-27 (ApplyBoard's help
centre answered 403; those claims are marked [search-index]). The patterns that apply, ranked: (1) a notification or queue
item opens the **exact requirement or thread** (the counter-examples Common App and Liaison CAS leave applicants to find
missing items themselves); (2) a cross-caseload work list whose row opens the item; (3) three-layer status — overall → per
application → per requirement; (4) enter once, reuse — show the existing document before "upload"; (5) dashboard numbers
that open their rows; (6) explicit handoff before an external portal. **Deliberately not copied:** admission-chance %,
High/Medium/Low, Likely/Target/Reach, business-weighted "best match" sort, rankings, AI essay/letter drafting, AI agents as
first contact, quick algorithmic "offers".

# 338. V26 Design-System & CSS Audit

Measured by `scripts/qa/v26/css-metrics.mjs` over the stylesheets each app actually loads, in load order
(`docs/qa/v26/css-metrics-before.json`):

| App | Files | Version-named files | Rules | Declarations | `!important` | Literal colours | Literal font sizes | **Shadowed declarations** |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| marketing-web | 19 | 9 | 1,721 | 5,961 | 31 | 124 | 89 | **82** |
| student-web | 24 | 9 | 2,397 | 7,990 | 60 | 170 | 124 | **151** |
| agency-web | 24 | 8 | 2,309 | 7,501 | 69 | 182 | 165 | **126** |
| university-web | 17 | 5 | 1,685 | 5,519 | 80 | 135 | 143 | **114** |

"Shadowed" = a declaration that a later rule with the identical selector, property, importance and at-rule context always
overrides — it can never apply. The largest sources: `console.css → console-v22.css` (52, the V22 white console redeclares
the V6 blue one wholesale), `university.css` self-shadowing (43), `v7.css → v16.css` (27), `styles.css → v2.css` (21).
Vendor sources (YNEX, Eduan, Koreanasha SCSS) are not counted and not edited.

Visual debt (computed, `VISUAL_DEBT.md`): tangerine used as a tint/secondary on console surfaces (A5); plan buttons on
`/services` not on the shared secondary (S10); console page titles cramped under the top bar (U1 capture); three different
"selected" treatments (filled tangerine segmented, peach row, ink underline strip).

# 339. V26 Performance / Accessibility Audit (baseline)

Measured on production builds (`vite build` + `vite preview`), one Chromium, median of 3 cold loads per route, 1440 × 900,
no throttling (lab, local); detail and AFTER in §348. Accessibility: axe-core serious/critical on the core routes of the four
products at 1440 and 390, keyboard walk of custom widgets, 200 % zoom reflow. Browser zoom and reduced motion had never been
reviewed before (RC-20).

# 340. V26 Implementation Plan

Ordered by user impact. One heavy process at a time; evidence in `docs/qa/v26/`.

1. **Exact-action deep links (RC-01).** Server: each caseload row carries `targets` (open university request, the thread
   waiting for our reply, the latest thread, the first document to review/fix, the nearest-deadline application, the next
   overdue staff task). One URL contract `focus=<kind>:<id>` on the agency workspace (opens the right tab, scrolls, highlights,
   opens the document drawer / selects the thread and focuses the composer). TODAY rows and the "다음 할 일" cell link to the
   exact target (the selected TODAY view decides which). Workspace "처리 필요" items open their record; reply-owed becomes a
   "처리 필요" item; the header primary is the next action. Student: document tasks link to `/documents?focus=<category>` /
   `?doc=<id>`; the Documents page scrolls to and highlights the requirement.
2. **Student Explore (RC-06/07):** fix `?lang`; "전체 프로그램" grouped by university (photo once), each programme row shows fit,
   first-year cost, language requirement, next deadline; the off-degree sentence once per group.
3. **Student Services "지금 진행 중" (RC-09):** server `now` lines per included service — items, state, owner, next step, date.
4. **University native headline (RC-08)** + applicant list filters (`requests`, `submitted_within`, `updated_within`).
5. **Console tangerine discipline (A5)** at the skin, not per page; census gate.
6. **CSS consolidation (RC-03):** version files → purpose-named canonical files in the same order; provably shadowed
   declarations deleted; gate.
7. **Copy:** particles (done), action codes, team wording, missing action keys in 33 markets.
8. **QA hygiene (RC-02):** residue purge/teardown (done) + `qa:v26` HYGIENE.
9. **Lint scope (RC-23)**, the V21 invalid-card precondition (RC-24).
10. **Agency scale test at 1,000 students** in a throw-away database, dropped afterwards (with the leftover V9/V13 scale and
    bench databases).
11. **Media:** bounded re-search of legal sources; storage de-duplicated (one copy of the university photographs).
12. **`npm run qa:v26`**, regression, production builds, Android ×3 sequentially + emulator smoke.
13. **Docs drift**, then **repository cleanup**, then the post-cleanup final run and hostile audit.

# 341. V26 Implementation Log

What changed, in the order of the §340 plan, with the deviations and the things that went wrong stated where they
happened. Evidence: `docs/qa/v26/` (documents named below) and `docs/qa/v26/completion/logs/`.

**Environment events during the pass (not product work, but they shaped it).** The WSL VM restarted five times on
2026-10-27 (19:05, 20:54, 21:45, 23:05 and once more before 00:00), each time under memory pressure from a sibling
project's job on the same 6 GB host; the 21:44 crash was `systemd` (pid 1) itself. A host maintenance routine
(`/root/wsl-maintenance/wsl-disk-monitor.sh`, 21:08–21:50) then deleted every repository's `node_modules`, the Playwright
browser cache, `dist-review/`, `playwright-report/` and `test-results/` as "regenerable". Nothing of this repository's
sources, data or documents was lost; `npm ci` (EXIT=0) and `playwright install chromium` restored the toolchain
(`completion/logs/npm-ci-restore.log`). Every long step in this pass is therefore resumable (checkpointed JSON, idempotent
scripts) and was re-run from its checkpoint rather than from the start.

**0 · Root causes fixed during forensics (before the plan).**
- QA residue (RC-02): 16 rows of gate residue were live in the demo data (10 "qa-v22 reply …" messages on a seeded student's
  thread, 6 "New student assigned: V21 Payment Probe" notifications). `server/scripts/purge_e2e.py` gained a gate-marker
  pass and `--check` (exit 1 on any residue); `scripts/qa/v22-gate.mjs` and `scripts/qa/v21/toss-test-transaction.mjs`
  purge at exit. Residue now 0 and gated.
- `server/.env` set `HG_PAYMENT_PROVIDER` twice (`demo` shadowed by `toss`); the dead line removed (RC-17).
- Korean particles (RC-26): a shared i18next post-processor (`packages/i18n/src/particles.ts`, registered in `initI18n`,
  so every web and native app gets it) resolves `{{doc}}을(를)` from the actual word — 성적증명서**를**, 여권**을**, IELTS**가**,
  PDF**를**; Latin letters and digits by their Korean reading; a closing quote is looked through. 4 unit tests.

**1 · Exact-action deep links (RC-01).**
- Server: `caseload._targets()` adds `targets` to every agency row — `request` (the oldest OPEN university request, or the
  returned application when the university only changed the status), `reply_thread`, `thread`, `review_doc`, `fix_doc`,
  `essay`, `deadline_app`, `task`, `app` — eight bulk queries for the whole page, never per row (`test_caseload_targets_are_bulk_not_per_row`).
  The workspace payload carries the same `targets` and, on each application, the university's open `requests` in its own
  words (label, note, category, due date, requested_at) — a thing the console had never shown.
- Agency web: `lib/focus.ts` maps the TODAY view in use, then the row's waiting reason, to one `focus=<kind>:<id>`; the row
  and its "다음 할 일" cell link there. The workspace reads `focus=`: opens the tab that holds the record, scrolls to it,
  marks it (`[data-focus]`, one shared rule in `@hangyul/ui` base.css — a tangerine edge and a fading warm wash, static
  under reduced motion), opens a document straight into the reviewer, selects a thread and — for a reply owed — puts the
  cursor in the reply box; a silent student with no thread opens a new conversation to them (`compose`). "처리 필요" items
  open their record (and the panel now lists an owed reply, so it no longer says "nothing is waiting" under a case strip
  that says "학생에게 답장하기"). The header's primary is the next action: **답장하기** when a reply is owed, otherwise 메시지;
  "할 일" is the neutral secondary. The case strip's "담당" cell names only someone in the team.
- Student web: document tasks link to `/documents?doc=<id>` or `/documents?focus=<category>` (the Documents page scrolls to
  and marks the requirement; a document opens its drawer); the "document returned" notification, the seeded notifications
  and the live demo rows were corrected to exact records (`/documents?focus=TRANSCRIPT`, `/essays/<id>`, `/messages/<id>`).
- **Found on the way (RC-26):** V25's TODAY item labelled **"대학 요청 / university requests"** was bound to the `university`
  view — "the application is waiting on the university" (under review) — not to `requested` (an open request or a returned
  application). The label and the predicate disagreed in all 33 locales, and the row opened an application nobody could
  act on. The item now uses `requested`; "대학 응답 대기" stays in the Filter select; the 33-locale label was re-keyed, not
  re-translated (its meaning was already "university requests"). `GATE_CHANGES.md` G-TODAY-1.

**2 · Student Explore (RC-06/07).** `?lang=` (every localized link since V14) was read as a search filter, so Explore
opened the 66-row "전체 프로그램" list instead of "나에게 맞는 31" — fixed with one `NON_FILTER_KEYS` set. The full list is
grouped under one university header per run (photo once; the server's relevance order kept), each row keeps first-year
cost · language requirement · deadline · scholarship, and "a different degree level" is said once above the list instead
of on five rows.

**3 · Student Services "지금 진행 중" (RC-09).** `server/app/services/services_now.py` builds one line per *included*

않아요"), essays and who holds each, the next consultation, documents being checked / to fix / verified, visa, housing,

상담팀 · 내가 할 일 · 대학), the next step as a link and a date. `/me/services` returns it as `now`; the page shows it first and

**4 · University native headline (RC-08).** `apps/university-mobile`: the web's four figures (결정이 필요한 지원자 · 답변을
기다리는 서류 요청 · 이번 주 새 지원 · 이번 주 진행이 바뀐 지원) as `HEAD_VIEWS`, each the total of the same list filter the web

**8 · Data quality found and repaired.** 24 status-history rows, 3 submissions and 6 applications were dated in **2027**:
the seed back-dated histories from "40–80 days before the deadline", which for far-off intakes lay in the future, and the
student page said "최근 변경 · 5개월 후". Seed clamped (deterministically — see §349 for the lesson), live data repaired by
`server/scripts/v26_repair_timelines.py`, and `--check` (impossible dates = 0) is in `qa:v26` HYGIENE.

**9 · University web.** Default order is **decision-first** (`sort=decision`: applicants who need a decision, longest-waiting
first, then everyone else) — V25 promised this and shipped "최근 제출순"; the headline figure and the first rows now agree.
The application page gained "최근 변경: <stage> · <when>".

**10 · Layout stability and accessibility.** CLS on the marketing university page **0.671 → 0.000** (`<main>` claims the
viewport while a page's code loads, so the footer no longer jumps into view and out), university console **0.150 → 0.012**
(the YNEX layout attributes are in `index.html` from the first paint; the toolbar's rows are fixed), agency 0.067 → 0.046.
axe serious/critical on the core routes: two contrast fails were opacity fades on text (the tri-column numerals at 1.91:1,
the empty-stage strip labels at 2.03:1) → solid colours ≥ 3.4:1 and ≥ 5:1; the analytics trend's `role="img"` hid its
focusable month links → `role="group"`. Reduced motion made the crest marquee overflow the page by 259 px at 390 (the
stopped belt kept its content width) → constrained.

**11 · Scale (brief §29).** `server/scripts/v9_scale_seed.py` took `HG_SCALE_STUDENTS=1000`; an isolated database
`hangyul_univ_scale26` (1,071 Lotus Bridge students, 2,159 applications), an isolated API on :8091 and console on :4702.
`scripts/qa/v26/scale.mjs` found two defects no gate had seen (RC-27): the TODAY figures endpoint at **11.7 s** median and
the ranked queue at **2.9 s**. Fixes, both with identical-answer proofs: `waiting.first_rule` expresses "the first true
rule" as one SQL `CASE` (each predicate once instead of the quadratic `AND NOT(all earlier)` form; `pred_legacy` kept as
the oracle a test compares against for every party) → the figures statement **574 ms**; a per-call memo warmed by five bulk
queries before the queue loop (`readiness.warm_memo`) → the queue **617 ms** in-process, **803 ms p95 over HTTP**. Also found:
an unknown `stage=` value reached PostgreSQL and came back as a 500 — the parameter is typed now (422, field named). Result:
all figures = rows at 1,071 students, the exact-action contract holds on every row, first paint of the complete Today
table 1.1–1.2 s, paging/search/filter/saved views/bulk bar/sticky header all correct at 1440 and 390 (`SCALE.md`).

**12 · Hygiene of the QA itself.** The V21 payment gate's "invalid card refused" check had been passing against
`/me/orders/undefined/…` whenever the order creation failed (RC-24) — it now asserts its precondition first. `lint:api`
scope widened (RC-23, §349).

**13 · What the measurements found after the captures.** Three things the AFTER numbers exposed, each fixed at the cause:
(a) the marketing production stylesheet had *grown* 249 → 276 KB while every authored count fell — the V7 build-time purge
had been selecting two marketing files **by path regex** and the consolidation's rename switched it off silently (RC-29).
The dead rules are now removed at source with the build's own PurgeCSS options (one exported definition), the path rule is
gone, a DOM probe shows 0 of the 301 removed selectors matching on 15 marketing routes, and the entry is **246 KB**, under
V25. (b) `zoom.mjs` found 26 route × zoom combinations with a control under 24 px — all four shapes fixed in the primitives
(switch hit box, link buttons, native checkboxes), not per page. (c) Explore's thumbnails loaded 640-px heroes into 36-px
tiles: 240-px renditions generated for all 332 photos, the photo reference now carries its rendition widths, images on
`/explore` 337 → 66 KB.

# 348. V26 Performance & Accessibility Results

`vite preview` against the development API; each route is loaded cold three times in Chromium (1440 × 900, Korean) and the
median LCP, CLS, long-task time, request count, transferred JS/images and API call count are recorded
(`scripts/qa/v26/perf.mjs`, `docs/qa/v26/perf-before.json` / `perf-after.json`, compared by `perf-compare.mjs`). BEFORE is
the tree at the start of V26 (2026-10-27 19:09); AFTER is the final tree. The host is a shared WSL2 VM: during the first
AFTER pass a sibling project ran six ffmpeg transcodes (load 11) and the agency home measured 1,060 ms; the row was dropped
and re-measured once the host was quiet (552 ms). That is the only re-measurement, and it is said here rather than hidden
(RC-25). Server-side latency at scale is in §341.11 and `SCALE.md`.

**What the numbers say.**
- **Consoles are faster at first paint** because they paint less, not because of a cache: student home 664 → 484 ms,
  application detail 532 → 268, agency workspace 832 → 464, university applicants 296 → 112, analytics 560 → 220. The
  mechanism is the exact-action contract (§341.3) and the toolbar/headline fixes — fewer re-renders and no late layout.
- **CLS.** Yonsei's university page shifted 0.671 (the hero mounted under the header and pushed everything) → **0** with one
  rule (`.ed-main { min-height: 100vh }` reserves the page before the hero arrives); the university applicants page 0.160 →
  0.010 (the YNEX layout attributes are on `<html>` before first paint, the toolbar rows are fixed-height); agency home
  0.067 → 0.046 (the TODAY strip no longer reflows when counts land). Still open: analytics 0.081 (the chart mounts after its
  data) and the marketing directory 0.065 (image aspect boxes on the first cards) — both in §352.
- **Explore images 0 → 66 KB** is a feature, not a regression: the grouped Explore shows a university tile per group
  (§343). The tiles were going to load 640-px heroes into 36-px boxes (337 KB on the page in the first AFTER pass), so a
  240-px rendition was generated for all 332 photos, the photo reference now carries its rendition widths and `UniMark`
  picks the smallest one that covers the box; 66 KB for every tile on the page, each `width`/`height`-attributed (no shift).
- **Entry CSS fell in all four apps** (−3 / −2 / −2 / −2 KB) once the version layers were merged and the shadowed
  declarations removed — and in marketing only after RC-29 was found (below). Entry JS did not change: V26 added no
  dependency. Total JS across all route chunks (18–19 MB) is the sum of every lazily loaded route and vendor chunk; no
  route loads more than its own chunk plus the entry.
- **Long tasks** are confined to the marketing home (212 ms: hydration of the full home with the marquee) and the
  directory; every console route is at 0 ms.

**RC-29 — what the bundle attribution found.** The marketing entry stylesheet *grew* 249 → 276 KB in the first AFTER build
although every authored count fell (rules 1,721 → 1,700). The cause was not CSS. Since V7 the shared Vite config had been
purging the two oldest marketing stylesheets **by path regex** at build time; the V26 consolidation renamed those files and
the purge silently switched off — and dev had been serving the unpurged files all along (368 rules in dev, 53 in
production). Resolution: the dead rules were removed **at source** with the build's own PurgeCSS options
(`scripts/qa/v26/prune-marketing-base.mjs` imports `templatePurgeOptions` from the config — one definition), 368 → 56 rules,
46 → 13 KB; the one PurgeCSS false negative (the RTL `unicode-bidi: plaintext` rule, dropped because `:where(p, h1, …)` is
treated as a conjunction) is kept on purpose; the path rule is deleted; a DOM probe shows 0 of the 301 removed selectors
matching an element on 15 marketing routes at 1440 and 390. Production entry: **246 KB**, below V25's 249. The layers of
that entry, each minified on its own (`docs/qa/v26/css-entry-composition.json`, pre-fix figures): Eduan chassis + glue 34 KB ·
Pretendard variable font faces 47 KB · tokens + `@hangyul/ui` 91 KB · marketing app layer 76 → 46 KB · Koreanasha 21 KB.
Two `qa:v26` checks guard it (G-CSS-5). The full account is RC-29 in `ROOT_CAUSE_MATRIX.md`.

**Accessibility (axe-core 4.13, `qa:v26` A11Y).** Serious/critical violations on the 14 core routes at 1440 and 390: **0**
(marketing 4 routes, student 5, agency 3, university 2). Three classes were fixed on the way: contrast of faded text set
with `opacity` (1.91:1 and 2.03:1 → solid tertiary ink, ≥ 4.5:1), a nested interactive SVG in analytics (`role="group"`),
and the reduced-motion marquee that pushed the home 259 px sideways at 390 (track and group constrained to the band).
Keyboard focus is visible on the first 12 focusable controls of every product (48/48). **Zoom and reflow**
(`scripts/qa/v26/zoom.mjs`, WCAG 1.4.4 / 1.4.10 / 2.5.8): 14 routes × 80 / 90 / 110 / 125 / 200 % + 320-px reflow — the
first pass found 26 route × zoom combinations with a control under 24 × 24 px (toggle switches 36 × 20, link-styled buttons
15–21 px, native checkboxes 13–16 px); all four shapes were fixed in the primitives, not per page (`.hg-switch` 40 × 24 hit
box on the unchanged 36 × 20 track, `.hg-btn--link` / YNEX `.btn-link` 24 px minimum, native checkbox and radio 16 px with
ink accent), and the second pass is **0 overflow, 0 undersized control**, applying 2.5.8's spacing exception exactly as
written (a 24-px circle meeting no other target). Captures at 200 % and 320 px: `docs/qa/v26/visual/zoom/`.

**Not claimed.** Lab medians on one machine are not field data; no RUM exists. Axe "0 serious/critical" is not "accessible":
the usability protocol (`USABILITY_PROTOCOL.md`) includes a screen-reader walk that has **not been run**. A second pass with every impact level and axe's best-practice rules switched on (`scripts/qa/v26/axe-inventory.mjs`,
`docs/qa/v26/axe-after.json`) found **0 violations of any impact on the 28 page loads** — which says more about axe's reach
(roughly a third of WCAG is machine-checkable) than about the product; the manual checks that remain are listed in §352.

  tree → symlink, caches, scratch, 51 unreferenced probes, 16 duplicate renditions + registry), then the **post-cleanup
  validation** from the cleaned tree (all ten steps green after the three fixes in §349), then the **Android phase** from the

  six V26 artifacts; `completion/logs/` one `*-final.log` per gate. **10,112 paths, 15.9 GB** removed, all manifested.

- **Not reversible:** there is no version control on this host (§352 #1). The manifest is the record.

# 352. V26 Hostile Audit — what is still wrong

Written last, against the final tree, by reading the evidence rather than the narrative. Items are ordered by the harm
they can do, not by how easy they are to fix.

1. **No version control.** The repository has no `.git`. Every V26 removal is recorded in `FILE_CLEANUP_MANIFEST.txt`, but a
   removal is not reversible and a bad edit has no diff. This is the single largest engineering risk in the project and it
   predates V26; V26 did not change it (that is a decision for the owner, not for a pass).
2. **Nothing here is field data.** Every performance number is a lab median on a shared VM; every accessibility result is
   automated; the localisation is machine-drafted. The usability protocol exists and was not run. The first real users
   will find things these methods cannot.
3. **Native parity gaps (`MOBILE_PARITY.md`)**: the exact-action contract (`focus=`) is web-only — native notifications open
   the screen, not the record; the native Explore still lists programmes one per row; the V26 "지금 진행 중" services view
   and the application "최근 변경" line are web-only; agency-native TODAY rows open the student, not the request/thread.
   Native app review by store reviewers has never happened.
4. **259 of 425 universities have no licensed photo of their own.** They show an owned/CC0 generic frame, never a fabricated
   or scraped one, and the directory says so — but a prospective student notices. External acquisition only
   (`MANUAL_MEDIA_ACQUISITION.md`).
5. **Accessibility beyond the gate.** axe reports 0 violations at every impact level, best-practice rules included, on the
   14 core routes × 2 widths (`axe-after.json`) — and axe can only see about a third of WCAG. No screen-reader walk, no
   switch-access session and no cognitive-load review has been done; the usability protocol holds all three. The review
   queue on a phone is a plain list of buttons with no visual "opens →" affordance (it works; it does not say so).
6. **Residual layout shift**: analytics 0.081 (chart mounts after data), marketing directory 0.065 (first cards' image
   boxes). The marketing home carries a 212 ms long task at hydration.
7. **Vendored YNEX console base**: 165 / 142 literal font sizes and the title-bar-around-everything composition on the
   console pages V26 did not touch (`VISUAL_DEBT.md` §3). Gated not to grow; not reduced.
8. **Scale test realism.** 1,071 students generated by one seed with uniform distributions; real agencies cluster by
   intake season and a handful of universities. The figures-endpoint fix is a real algorithmic fix; the absolute numbers are
   for this data shape only. The gate is host-sensitive: it failed under sibling load three times tonight with no code
   change (§349), which is why its budget is now median/p95 and `final.sh` records the load it ran under.
9. **Account deletion.** There is no self-service account closure endpoint; the only path is operator SQL. For a service
   that stores passports and bank statements for students in several jurisdictions this is a legal gap, not a UX one.
   V26 found it while tearing down a test account and did not add it (business logic; owner's call).
10. **Skips and conditional tests** (`GATE_CHANGES.md` skip inventory): the e2e paid-plan flow and two payment tests depend
    on the Toss test merchant and a key on this host; they ran today, they will not run on a host without them, and they
    skip rather than fail. The marketing live-smoke suite is `LIVE=1`-gated.
11. **History cites evidence that no longer exists.** REPORT §§1–329 reference `docs/qa/v3 … v25` images and logs that the
    cleanup removed (177 paths, none a live link from a current-state document). Their conclusions live in the Markdown
    summaries that were kept and in `ROOT_CAUSE_MATRIX.md`; the narrative sections were not rewritten, by rule.
12. **Two old probe scripts still name routes that no longer exist** (`scripts/qa/v10-removed-css-probe.mjs`'s V10 route
    list); they are referenced by their READMEs and were kept for that reason. Running them today tests fewer pages than
    their comments claim.
13. **The host.** Six VM restarts in two days, a routine that deletes `node_modules`, sibling jobs at 300 % CPU: every
    number in this pass was taken on that machine. The scripts are resumable because they had to be; a CI host would make
    half of §349's "reds" impossible.
14. **What this pass did not do**: no new feature behind the owner's three decisions (account closure, pricing changes, live
    payment keys); no iOS artifact; no human review of any locale; no change to the licensed vendor sources.

Not "perfect": a reader who finds something not on this list should add it to the matrix with evidence, which is how every
item above got there.

# 353. V27 Audit (written before any V27 change — 2026-10-29)

V27 is the **Admissions Intelligence, University Discovery, Application Accuracy & Native-Quality UX** pass. This section
and §354–§360 were written from the V26 tree and the live development database before a line of V27 code; §361 onward
records what was built. Evidence and re-run instructions: `docs/qa/v27/`.

The single most important finding, measured from the database:

| Table | Rows | `verification_status` |
|---|---|---|
| `institutions` (public directory) | 425 | registry facts (대학알리미 / IEQAS / Wikidata) |
| `universities` (application catalogue) | 10 | — |
| `programs` | 67 | **67 DEMO** |
| `document_requirements` | 130 | **130 DEMO** |
| `scholarships` | 24 | **23 DEMO**, 1 CURRENT |
| `dormitories` | 10 | DEMO |

**Every document checklist a student has ever seen was generated from seeded sample requirements.** No university in
the catalogue has a verified current admission guide behind it. The product has been honest about this in small print
(`data_quality: SAMPLE` on the quick check) and silent about it everywhere a checklist is shown. This is the defect §15–§18
of the brief describe, and V27 treats it as the first priority.

Other findings:

1. **Quick check (`/start`)** asks 3 questions (nationality · 3 degree options: 어학연수/학사/석사 · TOPIK or IELTS or none),
   has no doctorate, no GPA, no TOEFL on the marketing page (the student-web and native copies differ: 5 degrees, 5 kinds),
   and answers with **6 sample programmes from 10 universities**, all DEMO. Three separate implementations
   (`marketing-web/pages/Start.tsx`, `student-web/pages/Start.tsx`, `student-mobile/src/QuickCheck.tsx`) over one endpoint.
   The 425-institution directory is never consulted, so Yonsei appears only because it happens to be one of the 10.
2. **Language tests are hard-coded** as `LanguageTest {TOPIK, IELTS, TOEFL_IBT, DUOLINGO, SKA}` and
   `AdmissionRequirement.min_topik_level / min_ielts / min_toefl_ibt`: no TEPS, no TOPIK IBT, no KIIP/세종학당/어학원 수료,
   no per-track (Korean vs English) rules, no "accepted only by this university" representation.
3. **University detail**: `university_content.json` has, for 425 institutions: international-admissions URL 188,
   dormitory URL 112, international-office URL 105, verified official film 179, education philosophy 15. **Scholarships: 0**
   institution-level records; **language centre: 0**; **English-track: 0**; **dormitory cost: 0**; **support services: 0**.
4. **Official film choice**: of the 23 marquee universities, 18 carry a verified film and **every one is the domestic Korean
   brand film** (e.g. Yonsei "2025년 연세대학교 대표 홍보영상", Korea "[KOR] 2024 고려대학교 홍보영상"). No film is classified
   by purpose, so a foreign-student film can never win.
5. **Homepage marquee**: the 23 crests already link to `/universities/:slug` (V14) and `qa:marquee-details` checks 23/23.
   To re-verify, not rebuild: focus ring, hover affordance, the reduced-motion grid, hit size.
6. **Provider delivery**: `server/.env` contains **none** of `SENDGRID_API_KEY`, `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID`, `TWILIO_API_KEY_SID`,
   `TWILIO_API_KEY_SECRET`, `TWILIO_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID` (checked by name and length only). Outbound HTTPS from this host
   reaches `api.twilio.com` (200) and `api.sendgrid.com` (404 on `/`, i.e. reachable). The adapters are correct — Messaging
   Service, no `From`, API-key auth, sender `Hangyul Univ <support@talkhangyul.com>`. **The root cause is the missing
   credentials, not localhost.** Product gaps found on the way: a failed send answers a bare `DELIVERY_FAILED` (the user is
   told "try again" whether the number is invalid, the country is unsupported or the provider is down), and a FAILED
   challenge still counts towards the 60-s resend cooldown.
7. **Korean source copy**: 12,959 ko strings; **471 contain an em dash**, 385 a "label: text" colon pattern, 346 explanatory
   parentheses, 26 slash-joined phrases, 1 buzzword sentence (`marketing:v11.services.s1.text` — owner's Koreanasha copy,
   verbatim-gated, left alone).
8. **Localisation**: 33 markets, every locale `SYNTHETIC_NATIVE_REVIEWED` at most (machine-drafted, tool-checked). No
   locale has had a meaning/naturalness/context review pass with personas. No human review exists.
9. **Buttons**: the shared token secondary is a filled warm grey (`--hg-control-secondary-bg #F1EEEA`, no border, V25), but
   surfaces still carry their own button classes (`kn-btn--*`, YNEX `btn-*`, native `Button`); a rendered census across all
   surfaces has never been taken, so the "white button with a faint border" cases are unknown in number.
10. **Agency stages**: `StageStrip` renders a flat list of work stages with counts; there is no macro grouping, and the
    student workspace head does not answer "왜 멈춰 있나요 / 누가 해야 하나요" in one place.

# 355. V27 University enrichment audit

Scope chosen for verified research this pass: the **23 marquee universities plus Hanyang and Kyungpook** (the 10 catalogue
universities are all among them) — 25 institutions. Each gets a facts file with sources, links, international facts,
language rules per degree and track, scholarships one by one, and official films classified by purpose
(`server/app/data/research/v27/facts/`). The other 400 institutions keep their registry facts and show nothing they do not
