# 356. V27 Quick-check / matching audit

See §353 items 1–2. Design decisions for V27 (fixed before implementation):

- Inputs: nationality · study level (어학연수, 전문학사, 학사, 편입, 석사, **박사**, **석박사 통합**) · **GPA as entered with its own
  scale** (4.0/4.3/4.5/5.0/10/20/100/custom; stored as `raw_value`, `scale_max`, `normalized_percent`,
  `normalization_method = LINEAR_SCALE_PERCENT`, shown to the student) · language qualifications from a **test registry**
  (Korean: TOPIK, TOPIK IBT, KIIP, 세종학당, 대학 어학원 수료; English: TOEFL iBT, IELTS Academic, TEPS, New TEPS; other tests
  only count where a university's rule names them) or "아직 없어요". No major.
- Universe: **every active directory institution that offers the chosen level** (by institution type), not 10 catalogue
  universities. Four honest tiers — 현재 확인된 기본 조건 충족 / 한 가지를 보완하면 가능 / 도전해볼 만한 대학 / 현재 조건으로
  확인이 어려운 대학 — with no probability anywhere.
- Order: tier sections, and inside each the **추천순** discovery priority built from verified non-ranking signals (IEQAS
  우수/인증, verified data depth, scholarship fit, owner-curated marquee). Not called a ranking.
- One endpoint, one result row component per platform, one canonical university page.

# 357. V27 Admissions requirements audit

See §353. Rules for V27:

- New `admission_guides` table (one row per university × intake × degree × applicant type × track) with source URL,
  document, publication date, verified date, status `VERIFIED | STALE | REVIEW_REQUIRED | CONFLICT`, reviewer note.
- `document_requirements` gains `guide_id`, condition, original/copy, submission method, notarization, legalization rule,
  issuance age, source page and the evidence quote.
- **A checklist is generated only from a VERIFIED guide's requirements.** No verified guide → the application is in
  `ADMISSION_GUIDE_REVIEW_REQUIRED`, the student sees "대학 모집요강을 확인하고 있어요" and no checklist, and Hangyul staff see
  a review item. DEMO requirement rows are never used to build a checklist again.
- Legalization stays in the existing time-aware engine (`dossier.route_for`): the guide says *whether* a document needs
  apostille/consular confirmation, translation or notarization; the issuing country and the date decide *which*.

# 358. V27 Provider delivery audit

§353 item 6. Plan: map provider failures to user-actionable reasons (`UNREACHABLE` with a retry time, `RECIPIENT_INVALID`,
`REGION_UNSUPPORTED`, `RECIPIENT_REJECTED`, `SERVICE_CONFIG`), keep every entered field, exclude FAILED sends from the
cooldown, and add `npm run qa:identity-live`: configured/missing per variable (names only), SendGrid scopes and sender/domain
authentication where the key can read them, one real email and one real SMS through the product's own `verification.issue`,
Twilio message status by polling (no public callback needed for "accepted" vs "delivered"), and an exit code that fails when
configuration is expected but broken. No secret, code or message body is printed.

# 359. V27 Localization audit

§353 items 7–8. Plan: fix Korean source copy first (sentence by sentence; the verbatim Koreanasha strings excluded), then a
three-pass persona review (meaning → naturalness → UI brevity, then a source↔target comparison) per market locale over a
defined **core journey key set** (quick check, university detail, sign-up/verification, application checklist, documents,
legalization), priority languages first. Status recorded per locale **and per key set**; `SYNTHETIC_NATIVE_REVIEWED` is the
ceiling; `HUMAN_REVIEWED` is never written.

# 360. V27 Implementation plan

Order (brief §57, one heavy process at a time): research (background, network only) → data model + migration → loader for
research JSON → quick-match API + shared registry → `/start` (marketing), student-web and native → university detail
(scholarship summary, international, housing, links, film priority) → guide-gated checklists + legalization treatment →
agency stage groups + case head + legalization column → button hierarchy + census gate → provider error UX +
`qa:identity-live` → Korean copy pass → locale review → typecheck/lint → unit/API → e2e → visual → provider smoke → native
parity → Android if native changed → REPORT.

# 361. V27 Implementation log

Written after the work, against the tree. Research evidence lives in `server/app/data/research/v27/` (facts, guides,
reference, discovery) under the contract `docs/qa/v27/research/BRIEF.md`; it is loaded by `app/seed/v27_research.py`
(seed) and `scripts/v27_load_research.py` (live DB).

**Research (7 agents, official sources only).** 25 universities targeted (the 23 owner-supplied homepage crests plus
Hanyang and Kyungpook). Results: facts files for 24 (Sejong **quarantined**: its robots.txt disallows ClaudeBot, so the
evidence is held back, `research/v27/quarantine/README.md`); admission guides for 10 catalogue universities — 8 VERIFIED
2027 Spring undergraduate freshman guides (SNU, Yonsei, Korea, Hanyang, Kyung Hee ×2 tracks, Chung-Ang, Sogang ×2 tracks,
Pusan National), Kyungpook STALE (2027 guide behind robots-blocked paths), SKKU none (admissions host unreachable from
this network; the only other copy was on a ranking site, refused as a source). Study in Korea: its 이용약관 Art. 16
**prohibits** redistribution without NIIED approval — so nothing was scraped from it; the same data exists on data.go.kr
under "제한 없음" (15146912, 15146909) for a future import. GKS: NIIED's 2027 undergraduate and 2026 graduate lists,
matched by deterministic name expansion + a reviewed alias table to **98 institutions** (2 listed bodies are not in the
대학알리미 register). QS/THE: written permission required for commercial use → **no ranking data is embedded**; the order is
an editorial discovery priority and is labelled as such. WES iGPA moved to `https://apps.wes.org/igpa-calculator/`
(the old `applications.wes.org` URL now redirects to a login).

Corrections made while loading, each recorded in the evidence: KNU's three student video-contest films dropped as primary
candidates; KAIST/POSTECH "recommended" English scores stored as *test required, no minimum* (not as minimums); "no
language qualification required" rules (Ewha freshmen) stored as `NONE_REQUIRED`; groups made only of routes Hangyul cannot
check (a university's own test, exemptions) are *uncheckable*, never unmet; conflicts keep the freshest official rule
usable and go to the review queue (brief §16); Hanyang and Sogang guides (image-only PDFs, quotes transcribed by eye) carry
a reviewer note and appear in the queue as `SPOT_CHECK`.

**Data model** (alembic `v27adm0001`): `admission_language_rules` (institution × level × track × group × test, numeric
minimum + the source's wording, stage APPLICATION / ENROLLMENT / GRADUATION); `admission_guides` (intake, level, applicant
type, track, status VERIFIED / STALE / REVIEW_REQUIRED / CONFLICT, source document, publication date, reviewer note,
conflicts); `document_requirements` + guide id, Korean name, condition, machine-checkable `applies_to`, original/copy,
submission method, notarization, legalization rule, source page and evidence; `scholarships` + institution id, category
(GKS / UNIVERSITY / FOUNDATION / DEPARTMENT / LANGUAGE / ACADEMIC / HOUSING), stage (NEW / ENROLLED / BOTH), TOPIK and English
minimums, GPA text/percent, dormitory and living support, duration, renewal, period, restrictions, evidence. Verified
scholarships also write `ScholarshipRule` rows, so the signed-in engine reads the same source; DEMO scholarships of a
catalogue university are retired once verified ones exist. International facts, links and purpose-ranked films are merged
into the institution's one content record (`enrichment.intl`, `enrichment.youtube`, `enrichment.gks`).

**One registry** `packages/types/src/admissions.ts` → `shared/admissions.json` (`npm run admissions:sync`, checked by
`qa:v27`): 7 study levels (incl. 박사 and 석박사 통합), 13 language tests (Korean: TOPIK, TOPIK IBT, KIIP, 세종학당, university
course; English: TOEFL iBT, IELTS Academic, TEPS, New TEPS, plus TOEIC / Duolingo / PTE / Cambridge that count only where a
rule names them), GPA scales 4.0/4.3/4.5/5.0/10/20/100 + custom, the normalisation method, the four tiers, the sorts.

**Quick fit** (`services/fit.py`, `POST /public/fit`, 90 req/min/IP): every ACTIVE institution offering the level
(UNIVERSITY for 학사/편입, + GRADUATE_UNIVERSITY for graduate levels, JUNIOR_COLLEGE for 전문학사, listed language programme
for 어학연수) in four groups ordered by *known* disqualifications — MEETS (a verified route is met, or nothing is needed to apply)
· CHALLENGE (none known: rule unverified, or the open route is one only the university judges) · ONE_STEP (one requirement to
take or raise) · UNCLEAR (holding an accepted result but ≥ 3 levels / ≥ 25 % of the scale below) — monotone in the student's
scores, no probability anywhere. Rule groups inside a track are **alternative routes** (the research uses them for
department-specific minimums; the first ordering treated them as all-required and a better TOPIK pushed Yonsei *down* — found
by the simulations, fixed); best track per student (the track whose test family they hold wins ties); per-rule acceptance (TOPIK IBT ≠ TOPIK, TOEIC counts only where named);
scholarship hint only when a machine-checkable condition is met (GKS and foundation awards are never "you may qualify");
the "unlock" line names the test the student already holds first. Order = tier, then discovery priority (owner-curated
crest list, IEQAS 우수/인증, verified data, scholarship fit, real photo), then name. Snapshot cached 5 min. Shared UI
`@hangyul/ui` `QuickFitForm` / `QuickFitResults` used by marketing `/start` and student-web `/start`; native `QuickCheck`
rebuilt on the same endpoint and `fitReasonText` (`@hangyul/utils`). Answers ride the URL (`fitParams` / `readFitAnswers`)
into the university page and registration; `applyQuickToProfile` writes every language result and the GPA on its own scale.

**University detail** (marketing; shared components in `packages/ui/src/university-v27.tsx`): 유학생에게 필요한 정보 (language
rules per level and track, Korean programme, English-taught degrees, support services, GKS) → 외국인 유학생 장학 (strongest
scheme, "입력한 조건으로 해당할 수 있는 장학" and "{test} {min} 이상이면" computed on the server by the fit rule, count + checked
date, 장학 제도 전체 보기 grouped by category with conditions, renewal, source and date; *missing data says "not verified
yet, not none"*) → 학교 기숙사 (availability, per-semester cost, capacity) → academic identity; the film heading names its
purpose; official links add scholarship and Korean-language-institute pages. Endpoint `GET
/directory/institutions/{slug}/admissions` (directory list payload unchanged — nothing heavy on the list, brief §51).
Native: the university screen now falls back to a directory view for the ~415 institutions outside the catalogue (it used
to error) and shows the same verified scholarship/language facts; the seeded sample scholarship list is gone.

**Application requirements** (`services/guides.py`): `requirements_for` returns only the latest VERIFIED guide's rows for
the university × level × applicant type (track-neutral, then Korean track, deterministic). No guide → `[]`,
`ADMISSION_GUIDE_REVIEW_REQUIRED` on the application (`admission_guide` in the detail payload), readiness never reads as
complete, READY refused with that code, agency lists say 모집요강 확인 필요 instead of "0 left", HQ manage lists the queue
(missing guides by students waiting, STALE, CONFLICT, SPOT_CHECK; `GET /agency/hq/admission-guides/review`). Same round →
CURRENT; another round → PREVIOUS_ROUND with a visible note. Conditions: nationality / nationality_not / education country /
residence decided from the profile; undecidable conditional items show once as "해당할 때만 내는 서류 N개", not as tasks.
`LANGUAGE_CERTIFICATE` is met by whichever of TOPIK/IELTS/TOEFL the student uploaded. **Treatment** per item, on the
server: legalization NONE / APOSTILLE / CONSULAR / CHINA_CHSI / STAFF_REVIEW / UNSPECIFIED via the existing time-aware
`dossier.route_for` (issuing country, else nationality — and it says which), translation, notarization, issuance age,
original/copy, submission method, with the guide's quote and page. Seeded DEMO requirement rows never build a checklist.
The seed's READY→DOCUMENT_PREPARATION coherence step no longer demotes an application already handed off.

**Agency**: seven-stage progress rail (상담·준비 · 서류 준비 · 대학 지원 · 대학 심사 · 합격·등록 · 비자 · 입국·정착) over the existing
statuses (`caseStage`, no new state), done/current/next, current flagged when stopped ≥ 7 days or past a deadline, plus
최근 변경 — above the existing why/next/who/deadline/owner strip. Checklist rows: one issue label (업로드 필요 · 수정 필요 · 검토 중 ·
아포스티유 필요 · 영사확인 필요 · 학력인증(CHSI) 필요 · 인증 방식 검토 필요 · 번역 필요 · 공증 필요 · 원본 확인 완료 · 완료), who acts
next, and 근거 보기 (route + country basis, translation/notarization, form, age, condition, the guide's own words, the
student's proof status) — `requirementIssue` in `@hangyul/utils`.

**Buttons** (one hierarchy, tokens): SECONDARY = white + `--hg-control-secondary-border` #8A9099 (3.3:1), darker edge on
hover, sunken on press — applied to `.hg-btn` (the default), `.kn-btn--secondary/--outline`, YNEX `.btn-light`, option
cards, chips, segmented controls (selected = ink edge), form-control borders; danger gets a danger edge; 44-px phone targets
for every shared control (one block, specificity documented). Gate `npm run qa:v27-buttons`.

**Identity delivery**: `delivery_reason()` maps provider errors to UNREACHABLE (retry 30 s) / RECIPIENT_INVALID /
REGION_UNSUPPORTED / RECIPIENT_REJECTED / RECIPIENT_UNREACHABLE / SERVICE_CONFIG (retry 60 s); web and native show a
specific message with the resend time, keep every field, and a FAILED send no longer imposes the 60-s cooldown.
`npm run qa:identity-live` (names only, never values/codes/bodies; exit 2 BLOCKED, `--allow-blocked` → 0).

**Copy**: Korean source 601 rewrites (em-dash strings 471 → 16 occurrences, all deliberate: empty-cell markers, gated
owner copy), English source 815 rewrites (`docs/qa/v27/COPY_REVIEW_{KO,EN}.md`); `enrollment.TRANSFERRED` 편입 → 전출.

**Localization**: 727 student-facing keys (new + source-rewritten) × 34 locales = 24,718 strings, three persona passes +
comparison per locale (`docs/qa/v27/l10n/<locale>.md`), validator 0 problems, applied (24,518 changes in 204 files).
Status `docs/qa/v27/l10n/STATUS.json`: SYNTHETIC_NATIVE_REVIEWED ×34, never HUMAN_REVIEWED.

# 366. V27 Identity delivery results

SendGrid and Twilio adapters were already correct (Messaging Service, no `From`, API-key auth, sender
`Hangyul Univ <support@talkhangyul.com>`). Outbound HTTPS works from this host. **None of the provider values exists in
`server/.env`** (checked by name and length only; a filesystem search for them was refused by the permission policy and
not attempted again). `npm run qa:identity-live` therefore reports BLOCKED (exit 2; `--allow-blocked` → 0). No real email
or SMS was sent in V27, so the sender/domain authentication state could not be read. What is ready to run the moment the
values are present: scopes check (mail.send), single-sender and domain-authentication status, one real email and one real
SMS through `verification.issue`, Twilio delivery status by polling the Message resource (so "accepted" vs "delivered" does
not need a public callback; a callback check runs only when `HG_PUBLIC_API_ORIGIN` is public). Failure UX is now specific
(6 reasons, resend time, fields kept). Credential rotation remains recommended (they were exposed during V22 setup).

# 370. V27 Hostile audit — what is still wrong

1. **Real email/SMS delivery is unverified.** The credentials are not on this host; nothing was sent. The command that
   proves it is ready (`npm run qa:identity-live`). Rotation is still recommended once they are in place.
2. **8 of 425 universities have a verified current checklist.** Everyone else is honestly in review, which means most real
   applications would start without a document list. SKKU (network) and Kyungpook (robots-blocked 2027 guide) need a person.
3. **The ten-university catalogue's programme-level requirements (`admission_requirements`, `programs`, intakes, tuition) are
   still DEMO.** The signed-in matching engine, programme cards and the native "requirements" rows still read them. V27 made
   the public quick fit, the university page and the checklist honest; it did not replace the catalogue.
4. **Scholarship names are partly in English** because several research agents recorded the English name of a Korean
   scheme; a Korean reader sees e.g. "Korean Track new-student scholarship — TOPIK 3" on a Korean page. Needs the source
   Korean names re-collected, not a translation.
5. **Evidence transcribed from images** (Hanyang, Sogang, Ajou) has not been machine-checked; it is queued as SPOT_CHECK.
   No research was verified by a person.
6. **"Worth a closer look" holds ~195 institutions** for any bachelor's profile — honest, but large; the 12-row batches and
   the 추천순 order carry it. Expanding verified rules is the fix, not a different label.
7. **Localisation**: 34 locales SYNTHETIC_NATIVE_REVIEWED for the 727 V27 keys only; older strings in de/uk/tr/id/fil/kk/ky/cs
   still say "consular confirmation"; the pt bundle mixes pt-BR and pt-PT; `fa` `tier.REACH` reads "ambitious"; Polish
   `_few/_many` forms are stale; V27 console strings are ko/en only. No human review anywhere.
8. **Copy meaning issues listed, not fixed** (`COPY_REVIEW_KO.md` / `_EN.md`): ~40 particles after name placeholders
   (`{{agency}}가`), "key money" in the housing copy, the REACH label saying two things.
9. **Persona data vs real guides**: Lan's Pusan National application now lists every document the real guide asks for, most
   missing — correct, but the demo looks less "ready" than before.
10. **University console**: not changed (brief §26 asked for evidence-led changes only; no new evidence was gathered).
11. **Study in Korea data is not integrated** (its terms forbid it); the data.go.kr datasets that are licensed were found, not
    imported.
12. **Native**: only the student app changed; agency/university apps were not rebuilt, so their bundled locale strings are
    V26's. No iOS. Emulator smoke for the V27 student build: §371.
13. Nothing here is field data: no usability session, no screen-reader walk, no human reviewer of translations or research.

# 374. V28 Implementation log

What changed, by the audit finding it answers (`docs/qa/v28/UX_AUDIT.md`; outcome column added there).

**Design system**
- One result grammar for the quick fit (`packages/ui/src/quickfit.tsx`, `styles/quickfit.css`): a one-sentence summary of the
  strongest verified group with its basis (`fit.summary.<TIER>`, `fit.summary.basis`), then **"가장 먼저 살펴볼 대학"** — up to 4
  picks from that group only when it is MEETS or ONE_STEP (never from CHALLENGE / UNCLEAR) — then the tools (sort, region
  filter built from the result's own regions, GPA note), then the groups in display order MEETS · ONE_STEP · CHALLENGE ·
  UNCLEAR with the picks removed, 12 per group + 더 보기. V27 tier semantics and the server tiers are unchanged.
  `scroll-margin-top` stops the fixed header covering the result heading (MK-1, MK-2).
- Console buttons: Bootstrap's `.btn:focus-visible { outline: 0 }` outranked the global ring, so **every `.btn` in both
  consoles had no keyboard focus indicator**. One rule in `packages/ui/src/styles/console-v22.css` restores a 2 px tangerine
  ring for every variant, keyboard focus only (found by the button gate on the agency workspace).

**Marketing**
- University detail: "why this university" now leads with distinctive verified reasons (IEQAS, GKS, English-taught degrees,
  verified scholarships, languages, campuses, founding, breadth); the generic registry lines ("a national university", "has
  an international office", "has dormitories") are gone (MK-3). The researcher's English `note` field no longer renders as
  page copy (it is evidence).
- Hero fallback: campus photograph → official film still (only a poster a person reviewed as a campus scene, labelled
  "공식 영상 · <channel>", cropped from the bottom so a burned-in title band does not show) → identity composition (logo +
  typeset name). 3 institutions gain a film still (청주대, 국제대, 부천대); the 68 whose poster is a title card or portrait
  keep the identity composition (V25 rule, §312 D2). None of the three films is an international-student film, so the
  brief's "international film first" order changes nothing today; the chosen film is already purpose-ranked (V27).
- Directory (MK-6): each card shows at most one verified signal — verified scholarships (count) → GKS participation →
  English-taught degrees — from the API's new `signals` (absent = not verified, never "no"); the strings are the V28 detail
  "why" titles, already in all 34 locales. MK-5 was not changed (per-scheme sources were already behind the disclosure).
- Scholarship names as published (MK-4): alembic `v28sch0001` adds `name_native`, `name_official_en`, `name_display_ko`,
  `display_is_description`; 461 schemes reloaded — 281 with the native Korean name, 461 with a Korean display name, 240 with
  the official English name. `scholarshipName()` (`@hangyul/utils`) picks the Korean display name on ko and the official
  English name elsewhere, on the detail page and in fit picks.

**Student**
- `localName()` (`@hangyul/i18n`): university and programme names follow the UI language — 85 display sites in 22 web
  files and 22 in the native apps (ST-1, AG-3, UN-2); the API now returns `program.name_ko` with applications.
- Student-facing "counselor" copy says **한귤 상담팀 / the Hangyul team** (21 strings), including the privacy line; reviewer
  reasons and user text are isolated (U+2068/U+2069 or `data-user-content`) so a Korean page never reads as mixed-locale
  because of what a person typed. Messages scroll inside the thread, not the page. Upload titles drop empty brackets.

**Agency**
- Workspace head: the V27 7-stage rail is one quiet line (7-segment bar, current stage strong, "n of 7", next stage, stalled
  / overdue flag, last movement); the duplicate stage badge is gone (AG-2). Readiness blockers carry the Korean requirement
  name on ko (`detail_ko`, AG-3).
- Caseload deadline and "top university" now carry the Korean name (`university_ko`, `name_ko`) and render with `localName()`.
- Today: the separate work-type nav band is removed; the urgent count is the first item of the single filter strip and the
  saved-view select is shown on Today too — one band before the first row (AG-4).

**University**
- Home: decision → pipeline → outcomes. A pipeline line (submitted → offered → accepted → visa issued → enrolled) sits under
  the headline with each rate's denominator and a small-sample note under 5 ("Based on 4 records. Shown once there are 5.");
  links to analytics (UN-1).

**Data honesty**
- DEMO catalogue facts (tuition, intakes, minimums, requirement facts) are withheld — returned as `null` with
  `withheld: true` — whenever `HG_ENV=production` (`app/services/facts.py::withheld`, used by common serialisers, student cost,
  matching). Development keeps them under the global DEMO indicator. 3 API tests (D-1).

**Robustness found on the way**
- JWT decoding allows 10 s clock skew (`JWT_LEEWAY_SECONDS`, access tokens, signup sessions, verification proofs). The host
  clock stepped back 0.92 s in a 30 s watch (WSL2); a token issued just before a step failed `iat` validation as "Invalid
  token". This, not Redis, was the cause of the API tests that failed in a different place on every full run. SSO already
  allowed 60 s.

1. **Real email/SMS delivery is still unverified.** SendGrid/Twilio values are not on this host; nothing was sent

   persona reviews and the research are model work. No usability session, no screen-reader walk.
3. **Tier 3 consoles are mostly English.** `ar` agency 2,186 of 2,617 keys and university 1,471 of 1,759 fall back to English;
   the same holds for the other Tier 3 locales' console namespaces. A Tier 3 counselor sees an English console.
4. **"Needs checking with us" still holds ~195 institutions** for a typical bachelor's profile. V28 put the answer and four
   first picks above it; the bucket itself only shrinks as verified rules grow (8 universities have verified checklists).
5. **The ten-university catalogue is still DEMO.** In production its numbers are now withheld instead of shown as facts —
   honest, but the signed-in programme cards then show fewer figures.
6. **MK-5 not changed**: each detail section still carries one count/date line. **ST-2 reviewed, not changed.**
7. **Only 3 universities gain a film-still hero.** 254 of 425 still open on the typeset identity: the 68 with official films
   have title-card posters that V25 ruled must not lead, and 187 have no image of their own at all.
8. **The visual gate is a heuristic.** Its mixed-locale check counts English stopwords and exempts marked user content; it
   would miss a short untranslated label, and anything unmarked that a person typed counts as a leak.
9. **Clock skew on this host.** The WSL2 clock steps backwards (0.92 s once in a 30 s watch); token decoding now tolerates
   10 s. If the clock drifts further than that, the same "Invalid token" symptoms return.
10. **Owner copy left as is**: `marketing:v11.why.s3.text` promises a "successful life as a student abroad"; recommend removal.
11. **University names in stored task / notification parameters are English.** 50 server sites put `name_en` into a
    plain `university` field or an i18n parameter (tasks, notifications, submissions, dossier requests, visa reasons, sponsor
    view). V28 fixed display sites that hold the record (`localName()`) and the caseload deadline / top university; the rest
    need both names stored or a render-time map. The visual gate cannot see them (a bare name has no English stopwords).
12. **iOS not built** (no macOS host / Apple credentials); see §379.

# V29 PRE-IMPLEMENTATION (written before any V29 change — 2026-10-30)

V29 aligns the product with the owner's **new** service/pricing document (the "V29 contract"), clears the V28 hostile
audit (§378) and rebuilds the release gate around production readiness. Precedence for business scope: V29 contract →
implementation → PRODUCT.md → history. These sections record what the product did *before* V29 touched it; they are
not edited afterwards.

# 380. V29 Service contract diff

Measured from `packages/types/src/plans.ts`, `shared/plans.json` and the running API (`GET /api/v1/public/plans`,
dev, 2026-10-30) against the V29 contract.

| Item | Basic (V28 → V29) | All-in-One (V28 → V29) | Premium (V28 → V29) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Price | $179 → $179 | $349 → $349 | $599 → $599 |
| Consultation semantics | **30-minute** consultation → **1 diagnostic consultation + 1-day support period** | **60 minutes** → **3-day support period** | **90 minutes** → **support for the contracted service term** |
| Follow-up | 1 consultation → 1 follow-up consultation | "ongoing" (`null`) → responsible-team follow-up | "ongoing" → priority response |
| Recommended institutions | 3 → 3 | 5 → 5 | 7 → 7 |
| Managed applications | 0 → 0 | 2 → 2 | 3 → 3 |
| Document review | CHECKLIST → checklist | STANDARD → **review + correction guidance** | INTENSIVE → intensive review + correction |
| Statement / study-plan editing | 0 → 0 | **1 round → 2 rounds** | **2 rounds → unlimited within the contracted documents and schedule** |
| Mock interview | none → **paid add-on** | "separate product" → paid add-on | 1 → 1 included (more as add-on) |
| Visa | guidance → procedure guidance | document prep → document preparation support | intensive → documents + key-schedule intensive management |
| Dormitory | information → information | schedule → application-schedule management | application → application support + alternative accommodation |
| Arrival / settlement | none → none | information → basic living information | 30 days → **pre-arrival from D-30 + 30-day initial settlement** |
| Priority / dedicated | no → no | no → no | priority → priority + dedicated responsible staff/team |

Not in V28 at all: a **catalogue version / effective date**, a **purchase snapshot** of the contract, a **service
period** (start / end / support window), **pre-arrival** support, **dedicated support**, the six-item **add-on
catalogue** with price ranges and quote-only items, and the **이용 안내** service notes.

# 381. V29 Plan / entitlement audit

1. **Old semantics are encoded as data, not just copy.** `consultation_minutes` (30/60/90) is an entitlement; the
   comparison row renders it with `{{count}}분`; `services_now.py` keys the consultation line on it.
2. **Premium's essay line disappears for `null`.** `services_now.lines` gates the essay line on
   `(essay_review_rounds or 0) > 0`; making Premium non-rationed would silently hide its editing service.
3. **`null` = "not rationed" globally.** `entitlements.check` returns early on `None`; nothing bounds a non-rationed
   allowance by document type, application or service period — "unlimited" would be literally unlimited.
4. **No purchase snapshot.** `student_plan()` reads `ServiceProduct.entitlements` live; re-seeding the product with the
   V29 manifest would silently rewrite every V28 buyer's contract (and receipts show the live product name).
5. **`purchased_product` orders by `amount_minor`.** Any delta-priced upgrade order ($170) would rank below Basic
   ($179) and the student would appear to own the lower plan.
6. **Usage derivation is mostly right** (managed applications from history, rounds from review depth, recommendations
   from HANGYUL-sourced saves) but mock interviews count only COMPLETED, so a Premium case could book several.
7. **Recommended vs managed are separate fields** (good — kept).

# V30 — VISUAL INTEGRITY, INTERACTION RELIABILITY & FULL-SURFACE DESIGN QA (2026-11-01)

> V30 starts from a fact: the owner found visible defects in a product whose V29 visual/E2E gates were green. So every
> claim below is tied to a rendered page, a real pointer click or a measured box — and where a gate was wrong, the gate
> is named as wrong. Nothing in V29's service contract, prices, entitlements, application states, payment or security
> semantics was changed. One server change (§410.2) turns a 500 into a 422; it alters no behaviour for valid input.

# 407. V30 Marquee interaction root cause

## 407.1 Reproduced first

`scripts/qa/v30/_repro-marquee.mjs` (dev, ko, 1440 × 900), every row paused at the same fraction of its own loop,
`elementFromPoint` at each visible crest's centre:

| Loop position | Visible crests | Reachable by a pointer | Dead |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 % | 26 | 8 | 18 |
| 25 % | 27 | 2 | 25 |
| 50 % | 27 | 8 | 19 |
| 75 % | 27 | **0** | **27** |

A real `mouse.click()` on a visible Seoul National University crest left the URL at `/?lang=ko`.
Evidence: `docs/qa/v30/before/marquee-instances.json`, `before/marquee-1440-{0,25,50,75}.png`.

## 407.2 Actual root cause — `inert`, not an overlay

The correlation was exact: every dead crest was inside `[inert]`; every live one was not; the hit target under a dead
crest was its own `.kn-marquee__group` / `__track` (not a mask, overlay or pseudo-element).

`Marquee` (`packages/koreanasha-ui/src/components/layout.tsx`) renders, per row, two groups for the seamless loop and
repeats short lists until a group is wider than the viewport (`minItems = 18`; rows hold 8/8/7 crests → `repeats = 3`,
so **six copies of every crest per row**). V11–V29 made every copy except the first `aria-hidden` **and `inert`**.
`inert` is not an accessibility-only attribute: the HTML spec makes the browser **hit-test through** inert nodes, so a
click on any copy landed on the row behind it. One crest in six worked; at some loop positions none did.

**Why the gates were green.** `v14-marquee-details.mjs` read hrefs from the DOM and *filtered `[inert]` out before
testing* ("the reachable crests only") — it measured exactly the copies that worked. `v27/marquee.mjs` went further and
**required** duplicates to be inert (`fail('a duplicated crest is aria-hidden but not inert')`) — the defect was encoded
as an invariant. The V28 visual gate also skipped every control inside `[inert]`.

## 407.3 Second defect found by the new gate — the RTL belt emptied

In `ar` the band was **completely empty** at 75 % of a loop (0 visible crests; screenshot in `docs/qa/v30/marquee`). A
`width: max-content` flex track is anchored at the row's *right* edge in RTL with group B laid out to the left of A;
the keyframes still translated `-50%`, sliding the belt off its anchor. Fix: `[dir='rtl']` uses `kn-marquee-rtl`
(`translate3d(+50%)`), which lands B exactly where A was — the same seamless arithmetic as LTR. The V14 seam gate never
sampled `dir=rtl`.

## 407.4 Fix

- **One canonical data source** `apps/marketing-web/src/lib/marqueeUniversities.ts`: `UniversityMarqueeItem` =
  register id + slug + official names + crest + row; `universityPath()` derives the route in one place; a crest without
  id/slug is not rendered (the gate asserts the count still equals the manifest's 23).
- **Every rendered copy is a real link.** `Marquee<T>({ items, render, itemKey })` calls `render(item, { repeat })`. The
  canonical pass (group A, first repeat) is a normal link; every other copy is the *same* link with `tabIndex={-1}` +
  `aria-hidden` **on the anchor** (the per-item wrapper is `display: contents`, where ARIA is unreliable) and
  `onMouseDown preventDefault` so a press never focuses a hidden copy; the click still fires, middle-click still opens a
  tab. No `inert` anywhere. Keyboard and screen-reader users meet 23 links, once each.
- **Accessible name**: `aria-label` = `v30.unis.open` ("서울대학교 상세 보기", "View Seoul National University", …, 36
  marketing locales); the image's `alt` is empty so the name is not announced twice.
- **The whole slot is the hitbox.** The row gap moved *into* each anchor as `padding-inline: gap/2` (track gap 0), so one
  group still measures exactly `N·(crest + gap)` — the V14 seam arithmetic is unchanged (`qa:marquee` re-run green) —
  and there is no dead pixel between crests.
- **Restrained hover**: the artwork lifts 2 px and the rest of the row recedes to 72 % opacity; the transform is on the
  image, so the hit area never moves under the pointer; the row already pauses on hover/focus. Inset focus ring (the
  row clips vertically, an outset ring was cut off). No boxes, no pills.
- **Reduced motion**: the static grid shows the 23 canonical links (copies hidden), wrapped with a row gap.
- No JavaScript frame loop: CSS animation + semantic anchors; no listeners per frame; DOM count unchanged (same 138
  anchors as before, only attributes differ).

## 407.5 Gate — `npm run qa:v30-marquee` (`scripts/qa/v30/marquee.mjs`)

Production build (`dist/` served by `scripts/qa/v30/serve.sh` on :4630). Per locale × width, rows paused at 0/25/50/75 %
of their own loop; every crest instance whose artwork is ≥ 50 % inside the visible row is checked for: href =
`/universities/<own slug>` + locale policy; never `#`/`/universities`; `data-university` ↔ manifest; centre and four
inset artwork points hit-test to *this* anchor; link rect covers the artwork and spans ≥ 90 % of the slot; a **real
`page.mouse.click()` at the visible centre**, recorded by a capture-phase listener. Then one real, unintercepted click
per university per locale → URL, `<html lang>`, RTL `dir`, page heading = register name, scroll at top, API record
exists. Reduced motion (ko + ar, 1440 + 390): exactly 23 displayed, each hit-tested and clicked. Keyboard: exactly 23
tabbable crest links, 0 tabbable inside `aria-hidden`, every label contains the university name.

**Result (production, 2026-11-01):** locales ko en vi zh-Hans ar × widths 1440 390 × 4 loop positions →
**760 visible instances tested, 760 real clicks reached the right link (595 of them repeat copies)**; **115/115**
navigations landed on the right university, in the right language (ar in RTL), at scroll 0; **92** reduced-motion
instances; **0 failures**. Instance report: `docs/qa/v30/marquee/instances.json` (row, university, rendered-instance
index, bounding rect, href, click result, locale result); destinations: `destinations.json`.

The gate itself was not re-run on the BEFORE tree (that tree no longer exists — the repo is not under version control). The BEFORE defect was measured by `_repro-marquee.mjs`, whose hit-test is the same one the gate uses, and the gate additionally fails on `[inert]` and on a real click that reaches no link — each of which the BEFORE copies did.

Old gates corrected (not deleted): `v27/marquee.mjs` now fails if a copy *is* inert or a hidden copy is tabbable;
`v14-marquee*.mjs` read the name from the link's label.

## 410.3 Findings that were heuristic noise (and how the heuristic was corrected)

`detached-chevron` ×94 on `hg-account` (the phone chevron is `display:none` and measured at x = 0 → ignore unrendered
glyphs); `blocked-control` on truncated title links (an inline link's unclipped rect extends under the next column →
test the visible, clipped centre); `tiny-target` ×406 (text-style links and spaced checkboxes satisfy WCAG 2.5.8's
inline/spacing exceptions); `off-center-label` on icon-only buttons (descended into the glyph's paths → an `svg` is one
leaf); `inert-visible` on the closed off-canvas sidebar (covered by the page, not painted → only flag when the pointer
falls through to the element's own container); `oversized-select` on full-width fields inside padded parents (compare
with the content box). The `blank-main` findings in one run were cold dev-server loads under a host load of ~20 from
another session's WebKit suites; the same routes render in full on the production build (e.g. vi home: 4,531 chars).

Accepted with reasons (`docs/qa/v30/visual/ACCEPTED.json`): the in-field password toggle; the drawer covering the top bar
(by design, verified by stack probe); the agency catalogue's labelled student context picker; and five `mixed-locale`
items that are **content** (university-authored rule notes and essay prompts, official admission-guide titles).

| Question | Answer after V30 | Evidence |
|---|---|---|

| Can the band go empty? | Not in LTR or RTL (seam gate + marquee survey minimum per loop position) | `qa:marquee`, §407.3 |
| Does any short label float in a large empty box? | Not in any measured toolbar: oversized-select 62 → 0 on 103 routes; directory slack 0 px | crawl, `qa:v30-directory` |
| Is any chevron detached from its label? | No (detached-chevron 94 → 0 after removing the unrendered-glyph false positive; FilterSelect gap 6 px) | crawl |
| Do adjacent toolbar controls differ in height? | No (toolbar-height 9 → 0; directory ±1 px) | crawl, directory gate |
| Can a drawer's close button be covered? | No — overlays sit above console chrome | §414 stack probe |
| Can a decorative layer block input? | Not found (blocked-control / inert-visible 0 on 103 routes at two widths) | crawl |
| Does a card imply clickability without being clickable? | Not found (`partial-hit-card`, `pointer-dead-zone` 0) | crawl |
| Is any internal route marked with ↗? | No (`internal-external` 0) | crawl |
| Does a localized URL break a page? | The one case found (agency catalogue 500) is fixed and tested | pytest |
| Do heuristics prove the design is good? | **No.** They found candidates; each was opened. The sign-off lists what was looked at. | VISUAL_SIGNOFF.md |

# 435. P0 hotfix — public university discovery without the API (2026-11-03)

**Symptom.** `https://univ.talkhangyul.com/universities?lang=en` showed "0 institutions" together with "We couldn't
find that page." Local `:3100` showed the 425 institutions.

**Root cause.** Every public discovery surface fetched FastAPI: the directory list, region counts and detail
(`/api/v1/directory/*`), admissions (`…/admissions`), the Quick Fit country list (`/api/v1/meta/countries`) and Quick
Fit itself (`/api/v1/public/fit`). Locally the Vite dev server proxies `/api` to `:8001`. In production `/api` is
rewritten to `api.univ.talkhangyul.com`, where no API is deployed (the frontend-only scope, §436), so every call
returned 404. The directory then printed `total ?? 0` as "0 institutions" next to `ErrorState`, which renders any 404
as not-found. The marquee was unaffected because it already reads a generated manifest.

**Fix.**
- `scripts/public-data/export.py` calls the API's **own** public endpoints in-process over the canonical seeded DB
  and writes `apps/marketing-web/public/data/public/` (manifest with content hash, regions, 425 cards with the
  English order, 425 detail and 425 admissions records, countries, the fit snapshot). It is repeatable, and `--check`
  detects a stale export. No rows were hand-copied and no serializer was duplicated.
- `apps/marketing-web/src/lib/publicData.ts` answers those calls from the files with the API's response shapes.
  A load failure is a 503 "couldn't load" state with Retry. A 404 is only an unknown slug or an invalid filter.
  The count is no longer stated when the load failed. `/data/*` is excluded from the SPA fallback.
- Quick Fit and the per-visitor scholarship summary run `server/app/services/fit.py`, unchanged, in a Vercel Python
  function (`apps/marketing-web/api/public-fit.py`) over the exported snapshot, reached through rewrites of the
  API's own paths. `scripts/qa/public-fit-parity.py`: **16/16 responses byte-identical to FastAPI**.
- Public versus private boundary: only data an anonymous visitor already received from the public endpoints is
  exported. Accounts, applications, documents, messages, payments, tenant data and audit logs remain API-only.

**Gate.** `npm run qa:marketing-serverless` builds marketing and serves the production `dist/` with FastAPI offline
(`/api/*` → 503, Quick Fit → the function handler).
- Locally: **23/23**. That covers the bundle localhost scan, homepage, 69 marquee links (canonical slugs, locale
  kept), directory **425** in en, ko, vi, zh-Hans, ja and ar, search, region filter, a real empty state, the
  data-failure state, invalid slug → 404, the Quick Fit flow, the detail summary, scholarship rendering, **425/425
  detail routes**, and zero requests to localhost:8001.
- Against production (`BASE=https://univ.talkhangyul.com`), directory part, commit `78d61c8`: 20/20, including 425/425 routes.

**Deployments.** Directory fix `78d61c8` → `dpl_Cm4uHezoRjhkf7YnHhJuzupkDxxR`. Quick Fit function verified on
preview `dpl_63ukkmgcB2dZJvhtjgrHZGUwtjXS` (same tier counts as local FastAPI: 39 / 176 / 3 / 0, total 218), then
merged to `main`. The final production SHA is recorded in `docs/deployment/VERCEL_DEPLOYMENT.md` and served at
`/build-info.json`.

### 436.11 Service-unavailable state

`ApiError.unreachable` (network failure, 502/503/504 or a non-JSON gateway answer) → `api.unavailable` → the auth
provider's `AuthStatus 'unavailable'` with `retry()`. `RequireAuth` (web) and `AuthGate` (native) render
`ServiceUnavailable`: the brand mark, `common:states.unavailableTitle` ("We're getting the service ready"),
`unavailableText`, one Retry button — localized in all 56 bundles, no transport text, no demo data, no login form that
cannot work. The native login's emulator hint (`10.0.2.2:8001`) is gone from every locale. This is what
`app.`/`admin.`/`partner.univ.talkhangyul.com` show today, by the owner's decision to defer the private API.

- **University home** (`apps/university-web/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx`): the headline is one lead figure — applicants to

  queue and lost its box; outcomes stay a hairline strip at the end. Decisions → pipeline → outcomes. Native University
  home (`apps/university-mobile/app/(tabs)/index.tsx`): the 2×2 equal grid became one lead figure and a muted row of three.

- **Quick Fit nationality** (`CountrySelect`): the browser-default button is now the Hangyul trigger with the placeholder

  and 390).

### 436.13 Localization

- `docs/I18N_GLOSSARY.md`: one term per concept (document review ≠ verification, consultation not counselling, plan not
  package, standard admission letter, consular legalization, "visa document preparation" never "visa"), tone per product,
  the promise rule (say what we do; never admission or a visa).
- `scripts/i18n/v32/census.mjs` — 9,126 of 13,556 keys are active; `critical-keys.mjs` — 3,668 customer-critical keys;
  `jobs.mjs` — per-locale review jobs (marketing+common, consoles, student+mobile) with the reviewed English as the
  meaning reference; `apply-patch.mjs` — placeholder-checked, refuses untranslated lines, creates a missing key only when
  English has it, accepts CLDR plural families, logs every change to `docs/qa/v32/l10n/applied/<locale>.json`.
- **English first**: 283 strings revised across marketing, common, consoles, student and mobile (plan copy,
  states, pipeline vocabulary, console questions in a formal register).
- **Every market locale** (32 besides Korean and English) plus Urdu and Traditional Chinese (offered in the Student app)
  re-reviewed by a native-level synthetic reviewer in five passes (meaning, naturalness, clarity, tone, back-check) with
  the glossary: **48,606 strings changed in 34 locales, 38,816 of them keys that had no translation at all** and rendered
  in English — most of the Agency and University consoles and the native staff apps in nearly every market.
- **The Student app's deep screens** (application detail, visa route, dossier, writing, outcomes, arrival) were outside
  the first jobs, and their English had changed: the V9 coverage gate (`_student_status.json`), regenerated honestly,
  would have withdrawn 19 locales from the Student app. A second job per offered locale (`<loc>-deep.json`, 7,297 strings)
  reviewed exactly the stale entries; `scripts/i18n/v32/restamp.mjs` then records a current source hash only for keys a
  V32 reviewer saw. Result: all 19 offered locales at 100 % web and native — and Vietnamese, previously web-only in the
  native app (99.9 %), is now offered there too.
- Two English source lines broke the glossary and were fixed ("Preparing your visa documents"; "standard admission
  letter"). Russian `_one` families gained `{{count}}` (CLDR "one" also covers 21, 31…) and `_many` forms. Records: `docs/qa/v32/l10n/patches/`
  (with each reviewer's `_notes`) and `docs/qa/v32/l10n/applied/`.
- V31 open items closed: Polish register decided per product; ro/nl FAQ labels; Italian gendered forms; Arabic/Urdu
  ranges rendered per the reviewer's stated convention; `task.writingOverdue`; the three `_one` plurals.
- The V11 Russian fidelity gate (`scripts/qa/v11-copy-fidelity.mjs`): Korean stays the owner's verbatim source; the 25
  Russian halves that the review re-rendered are now pinned to the reviewed text and marked `ruRevised: "V32"` in
  `docs/qa/v11/koreanasha-copy.json` — a deliberate update, recorded.
- The 22 non-market bundles received the two new keys in their own language; nothing else in them was reviewed.
- Status: `SYNTHETIC_NATIVE_REVIEWED_V32` — **no human native review** of any locale, as before.

### 436.14 Native

Emulator run (`scripts/qa/v32/native-emulator.sh`, AVD `hg35`, Expo Go + Metro in CI mode against the QA stack):
University app signed in through the real form — login with no test sign-in, the re-weighted home in Korean and English;
Student app — login, home in Korean and Thai, the language picker. Captures:
`docs/qa/v32/shots/native/`. Defects found on the device and fixed:

- **Agency and University Settings drew the account card under the status bar** (tab roots without a native header
  must pad `top`) — fixed in both apps, re-verified on the device.
- **Production native builds pointed at development hosts.** The `production` EAS profiles set no environment, so a
  store build would have called `http://localhost:8001`, loaded campus photos and the checkout from `localhost:3101`, and
  opened the sign-up consent documents from `10.0.2.2:3100`. The profiles now set the public origins
  (`api.`/`app.`/`univ.talkhangyul.com`), the legal-sheet fallback is development-only, and `native-export.sh` fails
  if a production export contains a development host or lacks the public API origin. With the API deferred, a store build
  shows the service-unavailable state — never a localhost error.
- The Thai and Burmese fifth tab label truncated; shortened.

Expo Go was killed on its first launch after every fresh Metro start (host memory, as in V31) and worked on the second;
deeper native flows were not driven. iOS remains unbuilt (no Xcode on this host, EAS not authenticated).

### 436.14a Found by the final gates and fixed

- **Review mode removed.** `VITE_REVIEW_MODE` builds served canned API responses recorded from demo personas
  (`packages/api-client/fixtures/*.json`: fixture addresses, `test_payment_bypass: true`) — a mock API with demo members.
  The fixtures, the transport (`packages/api-client/src/review.ts`), `scripts/review/` and the `review:*` scripts are
  deleted; the leak gate found them.
- **Marketing links fell back to `localhost:310x`** in a build without Vercel's env; the fallback is now development-only.
- The native sign-up integration suite created an account on whatever API it found (the development database by
  default); it now runs only on the isolated e2e stack (`e2e-run.mjs --vitest apps/student-mobile`, chain step 13b).
- Two critical E2E specs still addressed pre-V31/V32 markup (the add-on table, the native nationality select).

### 436.16 Deployment

The commit that adds this section is pushed to `main`; Vercel builds the four projects from it, and `/build-info.json`
on each domain names that commit. `qa:marketing-serverless` is re-run against `https://univ.talkhangyul.com` after the
build (the result is in the release note of this pass, not here, so this section never claims a run it cannot have
seen). The three authenticated apps show the service-unavailable state (no API) — expected until the owner connects the
private API.

### 436.17 What is not done (honest)

- The private API is not deployed (owner decision); until it is, sign-up, sign-in and every authenticated screen on the
  production domains show the service-unavailable state.
- No human has reviewed any language; the review is synthetic, recorded per locale, with each reviewer's open questions
  (brand name in Chinese, plan terminology in Thai/Mongolian, institution-type glosses, localized example placeholders)
  listed in the patch `_notes` for the owner.
- Payments stay in Toss test mode; iOS is not built; the V25 Android store artifacts are superseded and must be rebuilt
  from this source.
